descriptionByLocale.it:
Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church’s, Car Shoe and Luna Rossa brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities.

JOB PURPOSE

To promote brand loyalty to customers in order to guarantee the quantitative and qualitative assigned objectives. To represent the Company, ensuring the implementation of all directions received from the Retail Department and Store Manager.

RESPONSIBILITIES

BUSINESS

• To be constantly up-to-date regarding fashion trends, monitor competitors and communicate the information to the Sales Staff.

• Reflect the corporate image in terms of standing and ensure that the Staff is also aligned.

• Support the Store Manager in guaranteeing excellent customer welcome and service and in maintaining the qualitative standards required by the brand.

CUSTOMER

• Promote customer loyalty.

• Foster a Client-centric mindset by developing and maintaining solid Client relationships.

TEAM

• Support the Store Manager in promoting an entrepreneurial and team spirit using effective communication and ensuring efficient organization.

• Ensure professional growth and training of the staff by sharing development plans with the Store Manager.

RETAIL

• Develop a proper sales strategy, in cooperation with the Retail Merchandising, Visual Merchandising and Retail Operations teams.

• Ensure synergy and cooperation between front and back office.

• Ensure that the Store image and product care are in line with corporate standards and secure that the Staff is responsible and committed to maintain these standards.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

Business driven

Leadership and team management

Ability to motivate and persuade people

Strong customer service mindset

Natural ability to welcome our client

Confident, enthusiastic and positive

Mature and assertive

Organized and detail oriented

Market and product knowledge/passion

Business/Retail Management degree or equivalent is a plus

Interest in luxury/fashion, art and design

English is a must other languages are a plus

Joining our Company means working in a creative and international environment, with teams of people motivated by curiosity and the quest for excellence. The engine of our success is the importance and value that we place on the talent and passion of our people leading to their own professional growth.
Prada Group promotes an inclusive work environment, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or other personal characteristics. We believe that diversity is a value and we are committed to build a fair and respectful workplace for all.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church’s, Car Shoe and Luna Rossa brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities.

JOB PURPOSE

To be the owner of the business, a Company Brand Ambassador and a business leader, accountable for overall store performance. To guarantee an extraordinary Client experience, being present on the sales floor, leading and supporting all activities to achieve store targets.

To manage and coach the store team and to ensure succession plans and internal growth.

RESPONSIBILITIES

BUSINESS

• Drive and maximize sales performances.

• Propose and develop business plans.

• Drive the store team to exceed their KPIs.

• Represent the Company on the local market, identifying new opportunities to increase customer footfall, attracts new Clients and builds a loyal relationship with the brand.

• Be present on the sales floor, ensuring a proper approach and service to the Clients.

• Foster the Omni Channel development through the team.

• Meet the store-operating budget, controlling store expenses.

CUSTOMER

• Foster a Client centric mindset by developing and maintaining solid Client relationships.

• Guarantee an excellent Client satisfaction and the highest level of Client service.

• Implement, in partnership with other company functions, clienteling initiatives and events, securing Client loyalty and increasing Client spending.

• Foster a strong private appointment culture.

TEAM

• Promote an entrepreneurial and team spirit using effective communication, ensuring efficient organization and professional growth.

• Ensure the team is always prepared and updated on the Prada Group main information, product knowledge, local market, competitors, policies and procedures.

• The ideal Store Manager is able to attract and recruit the best talents available on the market through networking and scouting.

RETAIL

• Develop a proper sales strategy, in cooperation with the Retail Merchandising, Visual Merchandising and Retail Operations teams.

• Ensures that the display attracts Clients and maximizes sales in accordance with Company guidelines.

• Participate in the buying session when requested and in any case he/she provides effective product feedback based on store needs.

• Ensure synergy and cooperation between front and back of house.

• Is responsible for the enforcement of Company procedures on cash activity, inventory, logistics and all the main reporting activities requested by the head office.

EVENTS

• Cooperate with the Retail Events Office for the organization of local events and defines a challenging and realistic target per Client, proposing new opportunities for local events in partnership with local Stakeholders and Influencers.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

Business driven

Leadership and team management

Ability to motivate and persuade people

Strong customer service mindset

Natural ability to welcome our client

Confident, enthusiastic and positive

Mature and assertive

Organized and detail oriented

Market and product knowledge/passion

Business/Retail Management degree or equivalent is a plus

Interest in luxury/fashion, art and design

English is a must other languages are a plus

The engine of our success is the importance and value that we place on the talent and passion of our people leading to their own professional growth.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church’s, Car Shoe and Luna Rossa brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities.

JOB PURPOSE

To be responsible of stock management in terms of KPIs, Corporate guidelines and procedures. To manage the stock team in order to facilitate the selling process through an impeccable stock maintenance and to be accountable of minimizing the stock losses. To ensure the implementation of all guidelines received from the Store Operations Department and Store Manager.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Ensure the safety of the products and the valuable material in the warehouse during the whole handling process .

• Ensure to properly manage the daily goods receipt, to arrange the merchandise following the corporate procedures and prepare the product to be taken on the shop floor and special areas.

• Organize, manage and perform the products’ counting and the stock takes.

• Assure the right product flow tracking through SAP system.

• Manage the stockroom activities related to Markdown.

• Guarantee the returns, shop-to-shop transfers, and e-commerce delivery following the corporate guidelines and deadlines.

• Ensure the security and cleaning of the stock facility.

• Optimize and organize the space available of all stockroom areas (cooperating with the Store Manager and the Store Operations Manager).

• Train, manage and evaluate the stock team.

• Coordinate and plan the staff’s activities, distributing the tasks and the responsibilities.

• Manage the assigned team through a constant training and coaching.

• Manage performance assessment interviews with the staff in accordance with Store Manager.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

Leadership and team management

Ability to motivate

Organized and detail oriented

Mature and assertive

Business/Retail Management degree or equivalent is a plus

Interest in luxury/fashion, art and design

English is a must other languages are a plus

descriptionByLocale.en:
Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church’s, Car Shoe and Luna Rossa brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities.

JOB PURPOSE

As the Brand Store Manager, you are a passionate Brand Ambassador and a business leader, who conveys the Brand philosophy and values to the local market, the Store team and to the final Client.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Leading the Business

• Drive Store Team to exceed Financial targets and maximize sales performances, determining the success of the entire store

• Propose and develop action plans, through careful analysis of performance

• Drive the Store team to exceed their KPI targets, including cross selling and up selling among product categories

Client Development

• Place the Client above all, leading by example to create a welcoming environment and to ensure the Team strives to meet their every need and request

• Foster a Client centric mindset developing and maintaining solid Client relationships and enforcing meaningful after sales experiences

• Guarantee an excellent Client satisfaction and the highest level of Client service through the execution of the “Brand Selling Ceremony”

Team Management

• Act as a strong Staff motivator, promoting team spırıt through effective communication, and cultivating a positive and energetic environment, even to the eyes of the Client

• Encourage the exchange of information within the team and proactively develop morning briefing on specific topics

• Master fully all company tools and applications including IT and digital, and ensure team is constantly informed of relevant updates

• Understand the needs and priorities, train and inspire the Store team on product knowledge, sales techniques, Client Services, and Company policies and procedures

Boutique Care

• Lead by example to ensure the Team operate with the highest level of care and respect for the Product, evident in every ceremony or procedure

• Ensure display attracts Clients and maximizes sales, in accordance with Company guidelines – proactively seek VM and MD support based on store needs

• Provıde feedback and suggestions when necessary to the Visual Merchandising and the Retail Merchandising departments

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

At least 8 years of experience

Strong problem-solving and organizational skills

Ability to manage multiple priorities and coordinate across functions

Excellent communication skills and team spirit

Fluency in both Italian and English

Joining our Company means working in a creative and international environment, with teams of people motivated by curiosity and the quest for excellence. The engine of our success is the importance and value that we place on the talent and passion of our people leading to their own professional growth.
Prada Group promotes an inclusive work environment, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or other personal characteristics. We believe that diversity is a value and we are committed to build a fair and respectful workplace for all.

Store Manager - Italia Mansioni - Affari - Guidare e massimizzare le prestazioni di vendita. - Proporre e sviluppare piani di business. - Guida il team del negozio per superare i loro KPI. - Rappresentare la Società sul mercato locale, identificare nuove opportunità per aumentare la caduta dei clienti, attrarre nuovi clienti, e costruire un rapporto leale con il marchio. - Essere presente al piano di vendita, assicurando un corretto approccio e servizio ai Clienti. - Promuovere lo sviluppo di Omni Channel attraverso la squadra. - Incontra il budget operativo del negozio, controllando le spese del negozio. - Cliente - Promuovere una mentalità orientata al cliente sviluppando e mantenendo solide relazioni con il cliente. - Garantire un'eccellente soddisfazione del cliente e il più alto livello di servizio al cliente. - Implementazione, in collaborazione con altre funzioni aziendali, iniziative di clientela ed eventi, assicurando la lealtà del Cliente e aumentando la spesa del Cliente. - Promuovere una forte cultura di appuntamenti privati. - Squadra - Promuovere uno spirito imprenditoriale e di squadra utilizzando una comunicazione efficace, garantendo un'organizzazione efficiente e una crescita professionale. - Assicurarsi che il team sia sempre preparato e aggiornato sulle principali informazioni del Gruppo Prada, conoscenza dei prodotti, mercato locale, concorrenti, politiche e procedure. - L'ideale Store Manager è in grado di attrarre e reclutare i migliori talenti disponibili sul mercato attraverso networking e scouting. - Vendita al dettaglio - Sviluppare una corretta strategia di vendita, in collaborazione con i team Retail Merchandising, Visual Merchandising e Retail Operations. - Assicura che il display attiri i Clienti e massimizzi le vendite secondo le linee guida della Società. - Partecipa alla sessione di acquisto quando richiesto e in ogni caso, fornisce un feedback efficace dei prodotti in base alle esigenze del negozio. - Assicurare sinergia e collaborazione tra fronte e retro di casa. - È responsabile per l'esecuzione delle procedure aziendali in materia di attività in denaro, inventario, logistica e tutte le principali attività di reporting richieste dalla sede centrale. - Eventi - Cooperare con l'Ufficio eventi al dettaglio per l'organizzazione di eventi locali e definire un obiettivo impegnativo e realistico per cliente, proponendo nuove opportunità per eventi locali in collaborazione con Stakeholders e Influencers locali.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Church’s and Car Shoe brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities. JOB PURPOSE To be the owner of the business, a Company Brand Ambassador and a business leader, accountable for overall store performance. To guarantee an extraordinary Client experience, being present on the sales floor, leading and supporting all activities to achieve store targets. To manage and coach the store team and to ensure succession plans and internal growth. RESPONSIBILITIES BUSINESS
• Drive and maximize sales performances.
• Propose and develop business plans.
• Drive the store team to exceed their KPIs.
• Represent the Company on the local market, identifying new opportunities to increase customer footfall, attracts new Clients and builds a loyal relationship with the brand.
• Be present on the sales floor, ensuring a proper approach and service to the Clients.
• Foster the Omni Channel development through the team.
• Meet the store-operating budget, controlling store expenses. CUSTOMER
• Foster a Client centric mindset by developing and maintaining solid Client relationships.
• Guarantee an excellent Client satisfaction and the highest level of Client service.
• Implement, in partnership with other company functions, clienteling initiatives and events, securing Client loyalty and increasing Client spending.
• Foster a strong private appointment culture. TEAM
• Promote an entrepreneurial and team spirit using effective communication, ensuring efficient organization and professional growth.
• Ensure the team is always prepared and updated on the Prada Group main information, product knowledge, local market, competitors, policies and procedures.
• The ideal Store Manager is able to attract and recruit the best talents available on the market through networking and scouting. RETAIL
• Develop a proper sales strategy, in cooperation with the Retail Merchandising, Visual Merchandising and Retail Operations teams.
• Ensures that the display attracts Clients and maximizes sales in accordance with Company guidelines.
• Participate in the buying session when requested and in any case he/she provides effective product feedback based on store needs.
• Ensure synergy and cooperation between front and back of house.

titleByLocale.de: MIU MIU CRM & Client Development Manager
titleByLocale.fr: MIU MIU CRM & Client Development Manager

descriptionByLocale.it:
Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church’s, Car Shoe and Luna Rossa brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities. JOB PURPOSE The CRM & Client Development Manager is responsible for developing and reinforcing a customer-centric culture across the region, ensuring the effective localization and execution of the brand’s global CRM strategy while elevating the overall client experience through impactful retail events, client engagement initiatives and tailored activations across all touchpoints. RESPONSIBLITIES
• Develop and implement the regional CRM & Events/Experience strategy, ensuring the localization and execution of the Global CRM vision across all group brands within the territory.
• Design, develop and monitor customer engagement and client recruitment initiatives through clienteling, client outreach activities, retail events and tailored experiences aimed at acquiring new clients while strengthening loyalty, retention and repeat business across different customer segments.
• Develop CRM insights and customer intelligence to support commercial initiatives, client activation strategies and personalized engagement actions across the client base.
• Manage budgeting and cost control related to loyalty initiatives, gifting programs, client experiences, festive activations and retail events, ensuring ROI measurement and performance tracking.
• Develop and execute strategic event plans supporting brand initiatives, retail openings, in-store events, MTO activities and high-end client experiences, ensuring consistency with brand image and commercial objectives.
• Collaborate cross-functionally with Retail, Marketing, Merchandising and Communications teams to support product launches, client activations, events and omnichannel engagement initiatives from a CRM and clienteling perspective.
• Oversee and manage local CRM training programs across the territory, promoting best practices in clienteling, data capture, customer contactability and customer engagement execution.
• Act as the local point of reference for CRM reporting, dashboards, customer analytics and performance monitoring related to client engagement initiatives and retail experiences.
• Supervise the adoption and optimization of clienteling digital tools, ensuring consistency in usage and alignment with business objectives.
• Act as the local point of reference for the NetPromoter System (NPS) and customer feedback initiatives, translating insights into actionable improvement plans for the client experience.
• Lead the conception, planning and execution of retail and client events, coordinating all involved company functions and external partners while ensuring alignment with creative briefs, brand standards and business priorities. KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Business or Engineering (MBA preferred) At least 10+ years of experience in business development, strategy, client development (Luxury industry is preferable but financial industry or consulting experience welcome) Excellent communication and client relations skills Expertise in Excel and PowerPoint to create effective presentations and experience drawing conclusions and recommendations from reports Experience in database management Flexibility with regional and international travel Familiarity with competitive marketplace and passion for consumer trends and development of personal customer relationships Experience in luxury, fashion, hospitality or high-end retail preferred Fluent in both English and local language (Korean) is a MUST Joining our Company means working in a creative and international environment, with teams of people motivated by curiosity and the quest for excellence. The engine of our success is the importance and value that we place on the talent and passion of our people leading to their own professional growth. Prada Group promotes an inclusive work environment, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or other personal characteristics. We believe that diversity is a value and we are committed to build a fair and respectful workplace for all.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Fondato nel 1913 in Italia, il Gruppo Prada si è costruito su una tradizione di eccellenza e con una visione di innovazione. Il Gruppo, leader mondiale nel settore del lusso, opera in oltre 45 paesi con i marchi PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church's, Car Shoe e Luna Rossa e conta dipendenti di oltre 100 nazionalità.

All’interno della Modelleria RTW basata a Montevarchi, stiamo strutturando un reparto di Modelleria dedicato all’abbigliamento tecnico-sportivo di Prada Linea Rossa. Le risorse si interfacceranno frequentemente con i team di stile e prodotto basati a Milano.

Nell’ambito di questo progetto, ricerchiamo:

Un/a Modellista RTW Performance Leggero (abbigliamento per running, training, tennis e sport estivi) con consolidata esperienza su prodotto leggero performance, preferibilmente con focus su running.

Un/a Modellista RTW Performance Pesante (sci, snowboard e sport invernali) con consolidata esperienza su capospalla invernale (capi imbottiti e piumini tecnici)

SCOPO

descriptionByLocale.en:
Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church’s, Car Shoe and Luna Rossa brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities.

JOB PURPOSE

To be responsible for the implementation and maintenance of the store windows and interiors assigned based on the guidelines and creative inputs defined by the Visual Merchandising Manager with the goal of increasing sales and in compliance with the brand image and company products.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Support the set up and maintenance of window displays and interiors, adjusting them to the type and merchandising of single stores.

• Set up and maintain in-store merchandising of the category, implementing the received guidelines and design inputs, based on sales trends, market peculiarities, customer target and reference competitors.

• Solve specific store visual merchandising challenges that require adaptations including store size and merchandising/inventory level.

• Co-ordinate with the Retail Merchandising Department to understand the merchandising guidelines and implement the visual strategy based on business needs.

• Cooperate with the Retail Merchandising Department for the implementation of appropriate outfits for the market, the customers and the season based on products in stock.

• Visit stores on a regular basis to ensure that Visual Merchandising standards are maintained in all of them.

• Provide appropriate indications to the In-Store Visual referring person.

• Cooperate with the Communication Department to the implementation of In-Store Events and Press Presentations, when required.

• Provide training to shop staff to ensure that the display is maintained up to corporate standards.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

More than 10 years of experience in VM for international fashion companies and/or in creative fields.

International and/or regional experience would be an advantage.

Proficiency in Photoshop and Illustrator and Adobe software.

Good interpersonal skills

Creative Mindset

Self-motivated

Able to work independently as required, but able to function as part of a larger team structure.

Willingness to travel

Good command of the English language and Local Language (Korean)

Joining our Company means working in a creative and international environment, with teams of people motivated by curiosity and the quest for excellence. The engine of our success is the importance and value that we place on the talent and passion of our people leading to their own professional growth.
 Prada Group promotes an inclusive work environment, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or other personal characteristics. We believe that diversity is a value and we are committed to build a fair and respectful workplace for all.

JOB PURPOSE

The incumbent is responsible for accounting activities relating to the maintenance of a complete and accurate general ledger and the resultant reports and financial statement.

RESPONSIBILITIES

ACCOUNT PAYABLES

• Manage Account Payable transaction and review the related evidence

• Perform Intercompany transaction recording and reconciliation

• Support vendor payment and employee reimbursement schedule with considering company rule

• Ensure compliance with Prada Group’s internal controls (ICoFR), tax regulations, and company policy

• Perform vendor communication for the payment queries and discrepancies

• Prepare monthly DPO (Days Payable Outstanding) analysis report

GENERAL LEDGER MANAGEMENT

• Review PO/Expenses notes and authorize relevant documents

• Post Accruals and provisions for expenses

OTHERS

• Prepare VAT filing quarterly

• Support internal and external audit

• Ad-hoc work for accounting

• Support special projects as requested

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

Bachelor’s degree in business, accounting

At least 3 years of working experience in a finance & accounting field

Excellent communication skills both in English and Korean

Excellent financial analytic skills on production of monthly, quarterly and annual management reporting

Excellent team player

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

Contract Period : From mid-July 2026 to the end of November 2027

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione Fondato nel 1913 in Italia, il Gruppo Prada è stato costruito su una tradizione di eccellenza e con una visione dell'innovazione. Il Gruppo, leader mondiale nel settore del lusso, opera in oltre 45 paesi con i marchi PRADA, Miu Miu, Church’s e Car Shoe, e ha dipendenti di oltre 100 nazionalità. L’acquisizione di Pasticceria Marchesi 1824 ha segnato l’ingresso del Gruppo nel settore alimentare, applicando gli stessi criteri di alta qualità. Molto proattivo anche nel campo dell'arte, il Gruppo Prada rafforza la sua presenza attraverso progetti di arte contemporanea in costante evoluzione. Unire la nostra Azienda significa lavorare in un ambiente creativo e internazionale, con team di persone motivati dalla curiosità e dalla ricerca di eccellenza. Il motore del nostro successo è l'importanza e il valore che mettiamo sul talento e sulla passione della nostra gente che porta alla propria crescita professionale. Mansioni JOB PURPOSE 
• Stiamo cercando i migliori consulenti clienti per le opportunità future nella vendita al dettaglio di lusso. Se siete appassionati di fornire esperienze client eccezionali, possedere un portafoglio clienti personale forte, e eccellere in un ambiente ad alto tocco, ci piacerebbe connetterci con voi! Unisciti al nostro pool di talenti per essere considerato per i prossimi ruoli Client Advisor. Questa persona servirà come “ambasciatore” che trasmette la filosofia e i valori del marchio. In quanto tale, ci sforziamo di massimizzare le prestazioni di vendita, promuovendo le relazioni con i clienti e sviluppando la loro fedeltà del marchio, fornendo un'esperienza unica in-store e guidando i clienti nel nostro mondo. RISPOSIZIONI - Benvenuto e servire il cliente, fornendo un'esperienza eccellente in-store in ogni momento. - Mantenere e sviluppare le relazioni con i clienti attraverso un approccio individuale, sfruttando anche gli strumenti CRM e digitali. - Impegnarsi attivamente in cross-selling con tutti i Dipartimenti e massimizzare le opportunità di vendita al fine di raggiungere obiettivi di vendita individuali e KPI. - Assicurarsi di essere aggiornato con le tendenze della moda e concorrenti. - Prove Brand e conoscenza del prodotto. - Affrontare efficacemente le lamentele dei clienti legandosi con il gestore di linea quando necessario. - Assicurare e mantenere il piano del negozio e la visualizzazione visiva ad un alto livello, in conformità con le linee guida operative e le procedure di stock. - Contribuire a garantire un elevato livello di sicurezza ed essere attenti a prevenire il furto del prodotto. 
• Requisiti CONOSCENZA E SKILLS - Passione per le relazioni umane e le vendite - Problem solving, curiosità e interesse per il lusso / moda, arte e design - Esperienza nella costruzione di relazioni durature con i clienti - Essere in grado di lavorare in una squadra e solo - Ottima comunicazione e competenze interpersonali - Passione e conoscenza della categoria dei prodotti gestiti - L'inglese è un must; altre lingue sono un plus Cosa? Questa posizione sarà pagata una tariffa oraria che può variare da $18.00 a $21.00, annualizzata da $37,440.00 a $43.680.00, e, se applicabile, può essere idoneo per commissioni, bonus e altre opportunità di incentivazione. Il tasso di retribuzione offerto può variare a seconda delle conoscenze, delle competenze e dell'esperienza legate al lavoro.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Church’s and Car Shoe brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities. The acquisition of Pasticceria Marchesi 1824 has marked the Group’s entry into the food sector, applying the same high quality criteria. Very proactive also in the art field, the Prada Group strengthens its presence through contemporary art projects in constant evolution. Joining our Company means working in a creative and international environment, with teams of people motivated by curiosity and the quest for excellence. The engine of our success is the importance and value that we place on the talent and passion of our people leading to their own professional growth. JOB PURPOSE We are seeking top Client Advisors for future opportunities in luxury retail. If you are passionate about providing exceptional client experiences, possess a strong personal client portfolio, and excel in a high-touch environment, we would love to connect with you! Join our talent pool to be considered for upcoming Client Advisor roles. This person will serve as the “ambassador” who conveys the brand’s philosophy and values. As such, we strive to maximize sales performance by fostering relationships with customers and developing their Brand loyalty, providing a unique in-store experience, and guiding clients into our world. RESPONSIBILITIES
• Welcome and serve the customer, providing an excellent in-store experience at all times.
• Maintain and develop client relationships through an individual approach, leveraging also on CRM and digital tools.
• Be proactively engaged in cross-selling with all Departments and maximize sales opportunities in order to achieve individual sales targets and KPIs.
• Ensure to be up-to-date with fashion trends and competitors.
• Prove Brand and product knowledge.
• Deal effectively with customer complaints by liaising with the line manager when necessary.
• Ensure and maintain the shop floor and visual display to a high standard, complying with Company operational guidelines and stock procedures.
• Contribute to ensuring a high level of security and be attentive to prevent product theft. KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS
• Passion for human relations and sales
• Problem solving, curiosity, and interest in luxury/fashion, art, and design
• Experience in building long-lasting relationships with clients
• Being able to work in a team as well as alone
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
• Passion and knowledge of the managed product category
• English is a must; other languages are a plus This position will be paid an hourly rate that may range from $18.00 to $21.00, annualized from $37,440.00 to $43,680.00, and, if applicable, may be eligible for commissions, bonuses, and other incentive opportunities. The rate of pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Descrizion Die 1913 in Italien gegründete Prada Group basiert auf einer Tradition der Exzellenz und mit einer Vision der Innovation. Die Gruppe, ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Luxussektor, ist in mehr als 45 Ländern mit den Marken PRADA, Miu Miu, Church’s und Car Shoe tätig und beschäftigt über 100 Nationalitäten. Die Übernahme von Pasticceria Marchesi 1824 markiert den Eintritt der Gruppe in den Lebensmittelsektor unter Anwendung der gleichen hohen Qualitätskriterien. Sehr proaktiv auch im Kunstbereich stärkt die Prada Group ihre Präsenz durch zeitgenössische Kunstprojekte in ständiger Weiterentwicklung. Der Beitritt zu unserem Unternehmen bedeutet, in einem kreativen und internationalen Umfeld zu arbeiten, mit Teams von Menschen, die von Neugier und dem Streben nach Exzellenz motiviert sind. Der Motor unseres Erfolgs ist die Bedeutung und der Wert, den wir auf das Talent und die Leidenschaft unserer Mitarbeiter legen, die zu ihrem eigenen beruflichen Wachstum führen. Mansioni GEMEINSAMER ZWECK Wir suchen Top-Kundenberater für zukünftige Möglichkeiten im Luxushandel. Wenn Sie eine Leidenschaft für außergewöhnliche Kundenerfahrungen haben, ein starkes persönliches Kundenportfolio besitzen und sich in einer High-Touch-Umgebung auszeichnen, würden wir uns gerne mit Ihnen verbinden! Treten Sie unserem Talentpool bei, um für kommende Client Advisor-Rollen in Betracht gezogen zu werden. Diese Person wird als „Botschafter dienen, der die Philosophie und Werte der Marke vermittelt. Daher bemühen wir uns, die Verkaufsleistung zu maximieren, indem wir Beziehungen zu Kunden pflegen und ihre Markenloyalität entwickeln, ein einzigartiges In-Store-Erlebnis bieten und Kunden in unsere Welt führen. VERANTWORTUNGEN - Begrüßen und bedienen Sie den Kunden und bieten Sie jederzeit ein hervorragendes In-Store-Erlebnis. Pflege und Entwicklung der Kundenbeziehungen durch einen individuellen Ansatz, der auch auf CRM und digitale Tools setzt. - Seien Sie proaktiv im Cross-Selling mit allen Abteilungen und maximieren Sie die Verkaufschancen, um individuelle Verkaufsziele und KPIs zu erreichen. - Stellen Sie sicher, dass Sie mit Modetrends und Wettbewerbern auf dem Laufenden sind. - Beweisen Sie Marken- und Produktwissen. - Behandeln Sie effektiv mit Kundenbeschwerden, indem Sie sich bei Bedarf mit dem Linienmanager in Verbindung setzen. - Sicherstellen und Pflegen der Werkstatt und der visuellen Darstellung auf einem hohen Standard und unter Einhaltung der Betriebsrichtlinien und Lagerverfahren des Unternehmens. - Tragen Sie dazu bei, ein hohes Maß an Sicherheit zu gewährleisten und achten Sie darauf, Produktdiebstahl zu verhindern. 
• Requisiti KENNTNIS UND FÄHIGKEITEN - Leidenschaft für menschliche Beziehungen und Verkauf Problemlösung, Neugier und Interesse an Luxus/Mode, Kunst und Design - Erfahrung im Aufbau langfristiger Beziehungen zu Kunden - In der Lage sein, sowohl im Team als auch alleine zu arbeiten - Ausgezeichnete Kommunikation und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten - Leidenschaft und Kenntnis der verwalteten Produktkategorie - Englisch ist ein Muss; andere Sprachen sind ein Plus 
• Cosa offriamo Diese Position erhält einen Stundensatz, der zwischen 18,00 und 21,00 US-Dollar liegen kann, der von 37,440.00 US-Dollar auf 43,680.00 US-Dollar annualisiert wird und gegebenenfalls für Provisionen, Boni und andere Anreizmöglichkeiten in Betracht kommt. Der angebotene Lohnsatz kann je nach berufsbezogenem Wissen, Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung variieren.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Descrizione Fondé en 1913 en Italie, le groupe Prada s'appuie sur une tradition d'excellence et une vision d'innovation. Le Groupe, leader mondial dans le secteur du luxe, opère dans plus de 45 pays avec les marques PRADA, Miu Miu, Church. L'acquisition de Pasticceria Marchesi 1824 a marqué l'entrée du Groupe dans le secteur alimentaire, en appliquant les mêmes critères de qualité. Très proactif également dans le domaine de l'art, le Groupe Prada renforce sa présence à travers des projets d'art contemporain en constante évolution. Rejoindre notre entreprise signifie travailler dans un environnement créatif et international, avec des équipes de personnes motivées par la curiosité et la recherche de l'excellence. Le moteur de notre succès est l'importance et la valeur que nous accordons au talent et à la passion de nos gens qui mènent à leur propre développement professionnel. Mansioni BUT DE L'EMPLOI Nous recherchons les meilleurs conseillers clients pour les opportunités futures dans le commerce de détail de luxe. Si vous êtes passionné par des expériences clients exceptionnelles, si vous possédez un solide portefeuille de clients personnels, et si vous excellez dans un environnement très tactile, nous aimerions nous connecter avec vous! Joignez-vous à notre bassin de talents pour être considéré pour les rôles de conseiller client à venir. Cette personne servira d'ambassadeur qui transmet la philosophie et les valeurs de la marque. À ce titre, nous nous efforçons de maximiser les performances commerciales en favorisant les relations avec les clients et en développant leur fidélité à la marque, en offrant une expérience unique en magasin et en guidant les clients dans notre monde. RESPONSABLES - Bienvenue et servir le client, offrant une excellente expérience en magasin en tout temps. - Maintenir et développer des relations avec les clients grâce à une approche individuelle, en tirant parti également de la CRM et des outils numériques. - S'engager de façon proactive dans des ventes croisées avec tous les ministères et maximiser les possibilités de vente afin d'atteindre les objectifs de vente individuels et les KPI. - Veiller à être à jour avec les tendances de la mode et les concurrents. - Prouvez une connaissance de la marque et du produit. - Traiter efficacement les plaintes des clients en assurant la liaison avec le gestionnaire de ligne au besoin. - Veiller à ce que le plancher de l'atelier et l'exposition visuelle soient conformes aux normes, conformément aux directives opérationnelles et aux procédures d'inventaire de l'entreprise. - Contribuer à assurer un haut niveau de sécurité et être attentif à prévenir le vol de produits. 
• Requisiti CONNAISSANCES ET COMPÉTENCES - Passion pour les relations humaines et les ventes - Résolution de problèmes, curiosité et intérêt pour le luxe/façon, l'art et le design - Expérience dans l'établissement de relations durables avec les clients - Être capable de travailler en équipe et seul - Excellentes compétences en communication et en relations interpersonnelles - Passion et connaissance de la catégorie de produits gérés - L'anglais est un must; les autres langues sont un plus 
• Cosa offriamo Ce poste sera rémunéré à un taux horaire qui peut varier de 18 $ à 21 $, annualisé de 37 440 $ à 43 680 $ et, le cas échéant, peut être admissible à des commissions, des primes et d'autres possibilités d'encouragement. Le taux de rémunération offert peut varier selon les connaissances, les compétences et l'expérience liées à l'emploi.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Church’s is a luxury shoemaker of rich innovation and traditional excellence, anchored in an exceptional heritage of English craftsmanship. Established in Northampton in 1873, the brand’s expertise quickly earned recognition from its modest beginnings – from a small workshop in Northampton to global expansion. Its patronage was bestowed by HM Queen Elizabeth II in 1965. In 1999, the luxury house was acquired by Prada Group, a paradigm of artisanal excellence in its own right and the ideal ally to help the shoemaker take its brand to the next chapter. Reinventing the English roots and championing timeless craftsmanship and traditions: Church’s long-established innovation and authenticity remains paramount with unique designs across shoes and accessories for men and for women. JOB PURPOSE To be the “ambassador” who convey and promote the Brand philosophy and Values to the final Clients guiding them into the world of the Brands. As such, to be responsible to maximize the individual and team sales, providing an extraordinary and memorable luxury customer experience placing the Client above all, discovering their needs and expectations, fostering meaningful relationships and developing their Brand loyalty. RESPONSIBILITIES
• Place the Customer at the center, creating a welcoming environment and striving to meet their every need and request, providing them with an excellence service in accordance to the “client journey ceremony”.
• Capture Customer data into the Company CRM with the purpose of connecting to the client, maintaining and developing the relationships to offer a personalized approach and develop future opportunities.
• Embrace and promote the Omni Channel mindset.
• Work as a team player and partner with fellow colleagues, foster open and constructive communication, to ensure a consistent exceptional experience and contribute to a positive working environment, embracing Diversity and inclusion values.
• Welcome and serve the customer providing an excellent in-store experience at all times.
• Be proactively engaged in cross selling with all Departments and maximizes sales opportunity in order to achieve individual sales target and KPIs.
• Ensure to be up-to-date knowing fashion trends and competitors.
• Prove Brand and product knowledge.
• Deal effectively with customer complaints by liaising with the line manager when necessary.
• Ensure and maintain the shop floor and visual display high standard, complying with Company operational guidelines and stock procedures.
• Contribute to ensure a high level of security and is attentive to prevent product thefts. KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS Passion for selling and stores Curiosity and interest in luxury/fashion, art and design Experience of building a long-lasting relationship with clients Being able to work in team as well as alone Excellent communication and interpersonal skills Ambition, resilience, self motivation, result driven and problem solving Passion and knowledge of the managed product category Joining our Company means working in a creative and international environment, with teams of people motivated by curiosity and the quest for excellence. The engine of our success is the importance and value that we place on the talent and passion of our people leading to their own professional growth. Prada Group promotes an inclusive work environment, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or other personal characteristics. We believe that diversity is a value and we are committed to build a fair and respectful workplace for all.

• Prepare shop-to-shop and returns transfers in compliance with company guidelines and timelines
• Prepare the flow of E-Commerce orders (Prada.com or e-Tailers) making sure to
• guarantee the required service levels
• Prepare the flow of the damaged products, not sellable product (On Hold, Consignment ...), products under repair
• Organizes the Packaging and Stationery physically and on the IT systems
• Organizes the Display objects system
• Ensure that the company guidelines are adopted in the event of theft, especially in terms of communication and documentation produced
• Support in the prompt investigation in the event of system negatives
• Participate in the organization and execution of the Physical and Cycle Inventories of the finished product and accessory locations (packaging / stationery and Engineering materials) respecting the company timing
• Support the management of the warehouse activities related to sales
• Ensure security and cleanliness of the warehouse KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS Fluent spoken English expected. High sense of responsibility. Being able to work in team as well as alone. descriptionByLocale.it:
Fondato nel 1913 in Italia, il Gruppo Prada si è costruito su una tradizione di eccellenza e con una visione di innovazione. Il Gruppo, leader mondiale nel settore del lusso, opera in oltre 45 paesi con i marchi PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church's, Car Shoe e Luna Rossa e conta dipendenti di oltre 100 nazionalità. SCOPO La risorsa sarà inserita all’interno del team HR dedicato all’area Pelletteria presso il nostro Headquarter in Toscana (Terranuova Bracciolini, AR) e fornirà supporto operativo alle attività di amministrazione del personale, recruiting, formazione e reporting HR RESPONSABILITA’
• Supporto alle attività amministrative legate all’assunzione e all’onboarding del personale, inclusa la predisposizione dei contratti e della documentazione correlata
• Inserimento e gestione della documentazione del personale nei sistemi aziendali
• Monitoraggio delle scadenze del personale in somministrazione e interfaccia con le Agenzie per il Lavoro (APL) di riferimento
• Supporto alle attività di selezione per figure dedicate alla produzione interna (es. tagliatori, preparatori, macchiniste, banchisti, ecc.)
• Supporto alle selezioni per le figure dedicate agli uffici dell’HQ industriale
• Predisposizione e aggiornamento della reportistica di selezione per ciascun plant di riferimento
• Aggiornamento della reportistica HR periodica (assenteismo, malattia, straordinari)
• Supporto operativo a 360° al personale REQUISITI Background accademico preferibilmente in ambito scientifico Interesse per il mondo delle Risorse Umane, in particolare per i processi HR in contesti industriali strutturati Buona dimestichezza con Excel e con i principali strumenti informatici (pacchetto Office) Approccio pratico e operativo, con capacità di lavorare su attività diverse in modo organizzato Buone capacità relazionali e predisposizione al lavoro in team Entrare a far parte della nostra Azienda significa lavorare in un ambiente creativo e internazionale, con team di persone motivate dalla curiosità e dalla ricerca dell'eccellenza. Il motore del nostro successo è l'importanza e il valore che diamo al talento e alla passione delle nostre persone, favorendone la crescita professionale. Il Gruppo Prada promuove un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo, garantendo pari opportunità a tutti i candidati, indipendentemente da genere, etnia, orientamento sessuale, disabilità, o altre caratteristiche personali. Crediamo che la diversità sia un valore e ci impegniamo a costruire un ambiente di lavoro equo e rispettoso per tutti.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Car Shoe nasce nel 1963 nella città di Vigevano, fiorente centro di produzione calzaturiera nel pavese. Coniugando la passione per le auto con quella per le calzature fatte a mano, l'artigiano italiano Gianni Mostile brevetta la prima scarpa driver dal design rivoluzionario: un mocassino destrutturato con suola montata su tasselli in gomma battuta. Negli anni Car Shoe si trasforma ad un'icona di eleganza sussurrata, associata a un lifestyle che coniuga raffinatezza, discrezione e un innato buon gusto. Nel 2001 il brand viene acquisito dal Gruppo PRADA, intenzionato a dare nuovo lustro a un marchio italiano sinonimo di artigianalità e innovazione, venendo quindi ripristinati l'immagine, il logo, lo stile e le qualità del modello originario SCOPO Per ampliamento dei nostri stabilimenti in area Valdarno, siamo alla ricerca di operai specializzati nella produzione di pelletteria, da inserire nei reparti di produzione per i brand Prada e Miu Miu. Nello specifico, ricerchiamo:
• Addetto/a macchina da cucire : esperto nella cucitura e assemblaggio di prodotti in pelle tramite macchine da cucire industriali piana, a colonna, a braccio, ecc.)
• Addetto/a al banco – Grande e Piccola Pelletteria: specializzato nel montaggio, incollaggio, colore, rifinitura e assemblaggio di prodotti in pelle
• Addetto/a alla Preparazione: specializzato nella spaccatura e scarnitura RESPONSABILITÀ
• Eseguire le lavorazioni nel rispetto degli standard qualitativi richiesti.
• Controllo qualità del prodotto durante le varie fasi di lavorazione.
• Utilizzo corretto di attrezzature e macchinari specifici del settore.
• Collaborazione con il team per garantire il rispetto delle tempistiche di produzione REQUISITI E CONOSCENZE Esperienza nel ruolo di addetto al Banco, alla Macchina da cucire di almeno 3 anni nel settore della pelletteria di lusso. Conoscenza delle tecniche di lavorazione della pelle. Precisione, attenzione ai dettagli e buona manualità. Capacità di lavorare in team e di gestire le proprie attività in autonomia. Flessibilità e capacità di adattamento a diverse fasi della produzione. Entrare a far parte della nostra Azienda significa lavorare in un ambiente creativo e internazionale, con team di persone motivate dalla curiosità e dalla ricerca dell'eccellenza. Il motore del nostro successo è l'importanza e il valore che diamo al talento e alla passione delle nostre persone, favorendone la crescita professionale. Il Gruppo Prada promuove un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo, garantendo pari opportunità a tutti i candidati, indipendentemente da genere, etnia, orientamento sessuale, disabilità, o altre caratteristiche personali. Crediamo che la diversità sia un valore e ci impegniamo a costruire un ambiente di lavoro equo e rispettoso per tutti.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church’s, Car Shoe and Luna Rossa brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities. JOB PURPOSE Supports the division in the preparation of budget and forecast defining, based on the CEO’s indications, cost and margin targets by product family and for manufacturing structures. Knows the economic and managerial trend and performance of the Division, all business indicators and provides detailed data analyses (cost data, economic data, overheads, production KPIs, operating results, etc.). Analyses differences vs budget. RESPONSIBILITIES
• Searches for and collects information required to prepare budgets and forecasts
• Prepares reports, analyzes Division results, compares margins and costs incurred and Budget objectives monthly and identifies the causes for any differences (changes to RM prices, contract manufacturing prices, RM consumptions, internal department efficiency, up to single item details)
• Prepares and discusses weekly reports for internal production plants
• Verifies seasonally that standard costs are consistent with set targets and guarantees Budget profitability
• Monitors finished products and raw materials inventories on a weekly basis to verify compliance with stock objectives; monitors recovery actions;
• Monitors sample collection costs based on the parameters specified in the budget itself
• Monitors on a weekly basis the timing of finished product deliveries to our warehouses, required to meet the commercial needs of the various distribution channels
• Monitors product defectiveness monthly
• Analyzes the management income statements
• Facilitates the exchange of information and communication with line functions
• Shares with the department manager the analysis produced through periodic meetings, supporting in the resolution of specific area problems
• Contributes to the continuous improvement of processes and analyzes carried out
• Analyzes investment proposals and calculates related financial KPIs (ROI; payback period; Make or Buy) KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS Degree in economics, statistics, management engineering Good knowledge of the English language Good knowledge of the Office packageKnowledge of SAP, Stealth, BOAbility to work under pressure, by objective and deadline Reliable and autonomous approach Joining our Company means working in a creative and international environment, with teams of people motivated by curiosity and the quest for excellence. The engine of our success is the importance and value that we place on the talent and passion of our people leading to their own professional growth. Prada Group promotes an inclusive work environment, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or other personal characteristics. We believe that diversity is a value and we are committed to build a fair and respectful workplace for all.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Description

Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in luxury, operates in over 45 countries with the brands PRADA, Miu Miu, Church's and Car Shoe, and employs over 100 nationalities.

SCOPE

The researched figure has a strong sensitivity to the product and a technical background in the area Luxury Clothing with proven experience on technical outerwear. Within the Prada Men Lifestyle Division, he will be responsible for managing the production chain related to sportswear, overseeing activities and operating flows of about 60 people. The role involves the coordination of the chain in the stages of prototyping, sampling and production, ensuring efficiency, quality and alignment with the Group's stylistic and industrial needs.

RESPONSIBILITY

- Management and coordination of personnel (approximately 60 people) and organization of the chain and workflow to meet the different needs (swimming, prototyping, sampling, production, advertising).
- Management of relations and information with the offices and departments closely linked (Product Office, Modelling, Cad, Production, Quality Control)
- Resolution of technical criticalities that can intervene in the development of a leader
- Develop reports about the progress of a collection.

REQUIREMENTS

- Excellent technical knowledge of luxury sportswear men's outerwear, made of nylon and technical fabrics
- 10-15 years of experience in the role of Laboratory Manager and/or External Technical Inspectorate
- Good knowledge of sewing machines and the ability to use them
- Autonomy in using Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint)
- Personnel management skills and job distribution and monitoring within the team
- Ability to develop reporting related to state of collection advancement.
- Aver obtained a frequency certificate at a specific course in clothing will be considered a plus.
- Retail care, flexibility and product sensitivity

What we offer

- Joining our company means working in a creative and international environment, with teams of people motivated by curiosity and the pursuit of excellence.
- The engine of our success is the importance and value we give to the talent and passion of our people, encouraging their professional growth.
- The Prada Group promotes an inclusive working environment, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or other personal characteristics.
We believe diversity is a value and we are committed to building a fair and respectful working environment for all.

La figura ricercata ha una forte sensibilità al prodotto e un background tecnico in area Abbigliamento di lusso con comprovata esperienza su capospalla tecnico. All’interno della Divisione Prada Uomo Lifestyle, sarà responsabile della gestione della catena produttiva relativa al capospalla sportswear, supervisionando attività e flussi operativi di circa 60 persone. Il ruolo prevede il coordinamento della catena nelle fasi di prototipia, campionario e produzione, garantendo efficienza, qualità e allineamento con le esigenze stilistiche e industriali del Gruppo.

RESPONSABILITÀ

- Gestione e coordinamento del personale (circa 60 persone) e organizzazione della catena e del flusso di lavoro per far fronte alle diverse esigenze (sfilate, prototipia, campionario, produzione, pubblicità).

- 10-15 anni di esperienza nel ruolo di Responsabile Laboratorio e/o Ispettore Tecnico Laboratori esterni
- Buona conoscenza delle macchine da cucire e capacità di utilizzo delle stesse
- Autonomia nell’utilizzo di Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint)
- Capacità di Gestione del personale e distribuzione e monitoraggio del lavoro all’interno del team
- Capacità di sviluppare reportistica relativa a stato avanzamento di collezione.

Warenbezeichnung

Die 1913 in Italien gegründete Prada-Gruppe wurde auf einer Tradition der Exzellenz und mit einer Vision der Innovation aufgebaut. Mit den Marken PRADA, Miu Miu, Church's und Car Shoe betreibt die Gruppe, ein weltweit führender Luxuskonzern, in über 45 Ländern und beschäftigt über 100 Nationalitäten.

ANWENDUNG

Die erforschte Figur hat eine starke Empfindlichkeit gegenüber dem Produkt und einen technischen Hintergrund im Bereich Luxuskleidung mit nachgewiesener Erfahrung auf technische Oberbekleidung. Innerhalb der Prada Men Lifestyle Division wird er für die Verwaltung der Produktionskette im Zusammenhang mit Sportbekleidung, Betreuung von Aktivitäten und Betriebsabläufen von etwa 60 Personen verantwortlich sein. Die Rolle ist die Koordination der Kette in den Stadien der Prototyping, Probenahme und Produktion, die Effizienz, Qualität und Ausrichtung mit dem stilistischen und industriellen Bedarf der Gruppe zu gewährleisten.

RESPONSIBILITÄT

- Management und Koordination des Personals (etwa 60 Personen) und Organisation der Kette und des Workflows, um die verschiedenen Bedürfnisse zu erfüllen (Schwimmen, Prototyping, Probenahmen, Produktion, Werbung).
- Management von Beziehungen und Informationen mit den Büros und Abteilungen eng verbunden (Produktbüro, Modellierung, Cad, Produktion, Qualitätskontrolle)
- Auflösung von technischen Kritiken, die in die Entwicklung eines Führers eingreifen können
- Erarbeiten Sie Berichte über den Fortschritt einer Sammlung.

ANFORDERUNGEN

- Ausgezeichnete technische Kenntnisse der Luxus-Sportbekleidung Herren Oberbekleidung, aus Nylon und technischen Stoffen
- 10-15 Jahre Erfahrung in der Rolle des Laborleiters und/oder externer technischer Inspektion
- Gute Kenntnisse der Nähmaschinen und die Fähigkeit, sie zu verwenden
- Autonomie bei der Verwendung von Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint)
- Personalmanagementfähigkeiten und Jobverteilung und -überwachung im Team
- Fähigkeit, Reporting im Zusammenhang mit dem Stand der Erhebung zu entwickeln.
- Aver erhält ein Frequenzzertifikat mit einem bestimmten Kurs in der Kleidung wird als Plus betrachtet.
- Einzelhandel, Flexibilität und Produktempfindlichkeit

Was wir bieten

- Unser Unternehmen zu begleiten bedeutet, in einem kreativen und internationalen Umfeld zu arbeiten, mit Teams von Menschen, die von Neugier und dem Streben nach Exzellenz motiviert sind.
- Der Motor unseres Erfolgs ist die Bedeutung und Wert, die wir dem Talent und der Leidenschaft unserer Menschen geben und ihr berufliches Wachstum fördern.
- Die Prada Group fördert ein integratives Arbeitsumfeld und gewährleistet Chancengleichheit für alle Kandidaten, unabhängig von Geschlecht, ethnischer Herkunft, sexueller Orientierung, Behinderung oder anderen persönlichen Merkmalen.
Wir glauben, dass Vielfalt ein Wert ist, und wir sind verpflichtet, ein faires und respektvolles Arbeitsumfeld für alle aufzubauen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Désignation des marchandises

Fondé en 1913 en Italie, le groupe Prada s'appuie sur une tradition d'excellence et une vision d'innovation. Le Groupe, leader mondial du luxe, opère dans plus de 45 pays avec les marques PRADA, Miu Miu, Church's et Car Shoe, et emploie plus de 100 nationalités.

PORTÉE

La figure étudiée a une forte sensibilité au produit et un arrière-plan technique dans le domaine Vêtements de luxe avec une expérience prouvée sur les vêtements extérieurs techniques. Au sein de la Division du style de vie de Prada Men, il sera chargé de gérer la chaîne de production liée aux vêtements de sport, de superviser les activités et les flux opérationnels d'une soixantaine de personnes. Ce rôle implique la coordination de la chaîne aux stades du prototypage, de l'échantillonnage et de la production, en assurant l'efficacité, la qualité et l'alignement avec les besoins stylistiques et industriels du Groupe.

RESPONSABILITÉ

- Gestion et coordination du personnel (environ 60 personnes) et organisation de la chaîne et du flux de travail pour répondre aux différents besoins (baignoire, prototypage, échantillonnage, production, publicité).
- Gestion des relations et des informations avec les bureaux et départements étroitement liés (Bureau des produits, Modélisation, Cad, Production, Contrôle de la qualité)
- Résolution des criticités techniques qui peuvent intervenir dans le développement d'un leader
- Élaborer des rapports sur l'état d'avancement d'une collection.

EXIGENCES

- Excellente connaissance technique des vêtements de sport de luxe pour hommes, en nylon et tissus techniques
- 10-15 ans d'expérience dans le rôle de directeur de laboratoire et/ou d'inspection technique externe
- Bonne connaissance des machines à coudre et aptitude à les utiliser
- Autonomie en utilisant Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint)
- Compétences en gestion du personnel et répartition et suivi des emplois au sein de l'équipe
- Capacité d'élaborer des rapports sur l'avancement de la collecte.
- Aver obtenu un certificat de fréquence à un cours spécifique en vêtements sera considéré comme un plus.
- Soins au détail, flexibilité et sensibilité au produit

descriptionByLocale.en:
Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Church’s and Car Shoe brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities.

 
 

 
 

 JOB DETAILS 

 
 We are seeking a passionate and dedicated Client Advisor (m/f/d) to join our dynamic team in our PRADA Store in Dusseldorf. As a Client Advisor, you will embody the essence of PRADA, ensuring that every customer interaction reflects our commitment to excellence. You will engage with our clients, understand their unique preferences, and offer expert advice to enhance their brand experience. 

 
 At PRADA, we are renowned for our unwavering commitment to luxury, style, and innovation. As one of the global leaders in the fashion industry, we are dedicated to delivering exceptional experiences to our esteemed clientele. Our brand represents a fusion of tradition and modernity, and our Client Advisors play a pivotal role in providing personalized service and creating memorable moments for our discerning customers.

 
 

 
 RESPONSIBILITIES 

 
 

• Welcome and serve the customer providing an excellent in-store experience at all times.
 

• Maintain and develop client relationships through an individual approach, leveraging also on CRM and digital tools.
 

• Be proactively engaged in cross-selling with all Departments and maximizes sales opportunity in order to achieve individual sales target and KPIs.
 

• Ensure to be up-to-date knowing fashion trends and competitors.
 

• Prove Brand and product knowledge.
 

• Deal effectively with customer complaints by liaising with the line manager when necessary.
 

• Ensure and maintain the shop floor and visual display high standard, complying with Company operational guidelines and stock procedures.
 

• Contribute to ensuring a high level of security and is attentive to preventing product thefts.
 
 
 

 
 KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS 

 
 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to connect with a diverse clientele.

 
 Strong sales and negotiation skills, with the ability to meet and exceed sales targets.

 
 Passion for luxury fashion trends, and an understanding of the luxury retail market.

 
 Fluent spoken German and English expected.

 Joining our Company means working in a creative and international environment, with teams of people motivated by curiosity and the quest for excellence. The engine of our success is the importance and value that we place on the talent and passion of our people leading to their own professional growth.
Prada Group promotes an inclusive work environment, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or other personal characteristics. We believe that diversity is a value and we are committed to build a fair and respectful workplace for all.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church’s, Car Shoe and Luna Rossa brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities. 

 
 

 
 

 Job summary/purpose 

 
 

 
 You are a passionate Brand Ambassador and a business leader/partner, who conveys the Brand philosophy and values to the Store team and to the final Client. 

 
 

 
 You hold yourself accountable for achieving a successful performance in your Department, supporting and implementing all activities to achieve the targets. 

 
 

 
 You guarantee excellence in Client experience, by being present on the sales floor and leading by example to placing the Client above all. 

 
 

 
 You are a motivating and inspiring manager; you coach and work closely with your team to achieve their sales target, maximizing all the commercial opportunities 

 
 

 
 Responsibilities 

 
 

 
 Leading the Business 

 
 

• 
 

• Drive the Department team to exceed Financial targets and maximize sales performances and contribution to support the success of the entire store 
 

• Support the Store Manager to develop and implement business plans, through the analysis of the department’s performances and proposal of relevant action plans 
 

• Drive the Department team to exceed their KPI targets 
 

• Foster cross selling and up selling among product categories 
 

• Be present on the sales floor, ensuring highest standard of approach and service to Clients. 
 

• Foster the Omni Channel awareness among the team, as well as encourage and support the team in using digital tools to improve the relationship with clients and achieving the business objectives 
 

• Foster the E-commerce channel development through a timely response to orders received, always delivering a high standard of service 
 

• Be constantly up-to-date on market trends (especially in relation to your department) and share ınsıghts wıth relevant functıons 
 

• Ensure display attracts Clients and maximizes sales, in accordance with Company guidelines 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 Client development 

 
 

• 
 

• Place the Client above all, leading by example to create a welcoming environment and ensure the Team strives to meet their every need and request 
 

• Foster a Client centric mindset developing and maintaining solid Client relationships and enforcing meaningful after sales experiences 
 

• Guarantee an excellent Client satisfaction and the highest level of Client service through the execution of the “Brand Selling Ceremony” 
 

• Proactively identify opportunities to gain new Clients in order to grow department sales 
 

• Strengthen Client loyalty supporting the Department team to carry out clienteling initiatives 
 

• Proactively manage any customer complaints to ensure client relationship is maintained with positive outcome 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 Team management 

 
 

• 
 

• Act as a strong Staff motivator, promoting team sp ı r ı t through effective communication, and cultivating a positive and energetic environment, even to the eyes of the Client 
 

• Encourage the exchange of information within the team and proactively develop morning briefing on specific topics 
 

• Master fully all company tools and applications including IT and digital, and ensure team is constantly informed of relevant updates
 

• Having understood the needs and priorities, train and inspire the Department sales team on product knowledge, sales techniques, Client Services, and Company policies and procedures 
 

• Identify talents within a team to propose for internal development opportunities, sharing the proposal with the Store Manager in order to define the correct development processes 
 

• Guarantee team development through coaching and follow-ups on individual action plans;
 

• Actively support the Store Manager in mapping the market for any researches they may have 
 

• Lead by example to ensure that the team operates with the highest level of care and respects for the Product, evident in every ceremony or procedure 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 Store Care 

 
 

• 
 

• Support synergy and cooperation between front and back of house 
 

• Support enforcement of Company procedures on cash activity, inventory, logistics and all main reporting activities requested by head office 
 

• Contribute to an effect ı ve and eff ı c ı ent care of Company’s assets 
 

• Prov ı de feedback and suggestions concerning department needs firstly to the Store Manager, and if necessary with the Visual Merchandising and the Retail Merchandising departments 
 

• Be the guarantor for an effect ı ve and eff ı c ı ent back of house organization for the department, taking responsibility for the protect ı on of the company’s assets as well as ensuring the staff grooming standard is maintained; 
 

• You ensure that Company policies and procedures are proactively put in place while managing all operational activities related to your Department. 
 
 

 
 
 

 

 
 

 
 Joining our Company means working in a creative and international environment, with teams of people motivated by curiosity and the quest for excellence. The engine of our success is the importance and value that we place on the talent and passion of our people leading to their own professional growth. 
 Prada Group promotes an inclusive work environment, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or other personal characteristics. We believe that diversity is a value and we are committed to build a fair and respectful workplace for all.

 JOB PURPOSE 

 
 

 
 To be the “ambassador” who convey and promote the Brand philosophy and Values to the final Clients guiding them into the world of the Brands. As such, to be responsible to maximize the individual and team sales, providing an extraordinary and memorable luxury customer experience placing the Client above all, discovering their needs and expectations, fostering meaningful relationships and developing their Brand loyalty.

 
 

 
 

 
 RESPONSIBILITIES 

 
 

• Place the Customer at the center, creating a welcoming environment and striving to meet their every need and request, providing them with an excellence service in accordance to the “client journey ceremony”.
 

• Capture Customer data into the Company CRM with the purpose of connecting to the client, maintaining and developing the relationships to offer a personalized approach and develop future opportunities.
 

• Embrace and promote the Omni Channel mindset.
 

• Work as a team player and partner with fellow colleagues, foster open and constructive communication, to ensure a consistent exceptional experience and contribute to a positive working environment, embracing Diversity and inclusion values.
 
 
 

• Welcome and serve the customer providing an excellent in-store experience at all times.
 

• Be proactively engaged in cross selling with all Departments and maximizes sales opportunity in order to achieve individual sales target and KPIs.
 

• Ensure to be up-to-date knowing fashion trends and competitors.
 

• Prove Brand and product knowledge.
 

• Deal effectively with customer complaints by liaising with the line manager when necessary.
 

• Ensure and maintain the shop floor and visual display high standard, complying with Company operational guidelines and stock procedures.
 

• Contribute to ensure a high level of security and is attentive to prevent product thefts.

 Passion for selling and stores

 
 Curiosity and interest in luxury/fashion, art and design

 
 Experience of building a long-lasting relationship with clients

 
 Being able to work in team as well as alone

 
 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

 
 Ambition, resilience, self motivation, result driven and problem solving

 
 Passion and knowledge of the managed product category

 
 English is a must other languages are a plus

descriptionByLocale.en:
Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church’s, Car Shoe and Luna Rossa brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities.

 
 

 
 

 
 
 JOB PURPOSE 

 
 

 
 We are seeking a passionate and dedicated Sales Associate (m/f/d) with 32h/week to join our dynamic team in our Prada Outlet in Roermond. As a Client Advisor (m/f/d), you will represent the Company towards customers and achieve the quantitative and qualitative objectives for the Department and the Store.

 
 

 
 RESPONSIBILITIES 

 
 

 
 

• Manage sales and optimize each step of the sales process.
 

• Understand the customer’s needs, both expressed and hidden.
 

• Present and value the product range.
 

• Boost cross-selling and additional sales.
 

• Ensure the correct management (cleaning, care, replacement) of the products in the department.
 
 
 

 
 

 
 KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS 

 
 Passion for human relations and sales

 
 Problem solving, curiosity and interest in luxury/fashion, art and design

 
 Experience of building a long-lasting relationship with clients

 
 Being able to work in team as well as alone

 
 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

 
 Passion and knowledge of the managed product category

 
 Fluent spoken English expected

descriptionByLocale.en:
Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church’s, Car Shoe and Luna Rossa brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities.

 
 

 
 

 JOB PURPOSE 

 
 

 
 We are looking for a 24h-parttime Cashier (m/f/d) for our PRADA Outlet in Roermond who supports the activities connected to cash collection (payments, advances, returns, invoices, credit notes, bank transfers for distance selling, deposits) following the Corporate guidelines.

 
 

 
 

 
 RESPONSIBILITIES 

 
 

 
 

• Execute cash opening and closing procedures, verifying cash availability in cash registers and the functioning of equipment to be used.
 

• Issue national, international and tax free invoices in compliance with local laws.
 

• Support advances, returns (returns are normally processed by sales associates), issuance of vouchers and credit notes to customers.
 

• Follow CITES procedures – for products needing them.
 

• Monitor credit card payments and bank transfers.
 

• Carry out and print daily cash register closing, checking daily cash in
 

• Prepare paying-in slips and, where necessary, the documents for periodical withdrawal, managing delivery and relevant receipts.
 

• Update the company’s customer database.
 

• Manage petty cash in compliance with corporate procedures in terms of expense limits.
 
 
 

 
 KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS 

 
 Related experience, Retail channel preferred

 
 Good integrity, organized, strong sense of responsibility

 
 Being able to work in team as well as alone

 
 Fluent spoken English expected

 

 
 

 
 Joining our Company means working in a creative and international environment, with teams of people motivated by curiosity and the quest for excellence. The engine of our success is the importance and value that we place on the talent and passion of our people leading to their own professional growth.
