descriptionByLocale.en:
Church’s is a luxury shoemaker of rich innovation and traditional excellence, anchored in an exceptional heritage of English craftsmanship. Established in Northampton in 1873, the brand’s expertise quickly earned recognition from its modest beginnings – from a small workshop in Northampton to global expansion. Its patronage was bestowed by HM Queen Elizabeth II in 1965. In 1999, the luxury house was acquired by Prada Group, a paradigm of artisanal excellence in its own right and the ideal ally to help the shoemaker take its brand to the next chapter. Reinventing the English roots and championing timeless craftsmanship and traditions: Church’s long-established innovation and authenticity remains paramount with unique designs across shoes and accessories for men and for women. 

 
 

 
 

 JOB PURPOSE 

 
 

 
 To be the “ambassador” who convey and promote the Brand philosophy and Values to the final Clients guiding them into the world of the Brands. As such, to be responsible to maximize the individual and team sales, providing an extraordinary and memorable luxury customer experience placing the Client above all, discovering their needs and expectations, fostering meaningful relationships and developing their Brand loyalty. 

 
 

 
 

 
 RESPONSIBILITIES 

 
 

 
 

• Place the Customer at the center, creating a welcoming environment and striving to meet their every need and request, providing them with an excellence service in accordance to the “client journey ceremony”. 
 

• Capture Customer data into the Company CRM with the purpose of connecting to the client, maintaining and developing the relationships to offer a personalized approach and develop future opportunities. 
 

• Embrace and promote the Omni Channel mindset. 
 

• Work as a team player and partner with fellow colleagues, foster open and constructive communication, to ensure a consistent exceptional experience and contribute to a positive working environment, embracing Diversity and inclusion values. 
 
 
 

• Welcome and serve the customer providing an excellent in-store experience at all times. 
 

• Be proactively engaged in cross selling with all Departments and maximizes sales opportunity in order to achieve individual sales target and KPIs. 
 

• Ensure to be up-to-date knowing fashion trends and competitors. 
 

• Prove Brand and product knowledge. 
 

• Deal effectively with customer complaints by liaising with the line manager when necessary. 
 

• Ensure and maintain the shop floor and visual display high standard, complying with Company operational guidelines and stock procedures. 
 

• Contribute to ensure a high level of security and is attentive to prevent product thefts. 
 
 
 

 
 

 
 KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS 

 
 

 
 Passion for selling and stores 

 
 Curiosity and interest in luxury/fashion, art and design 

 
 Experience of building a long-lasting relationship with clients 

 
 Being able to work in team as well as alone 

 
 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills 

 
 Ambition, resilience, self motivation, result driven and problem solving 

 
 Passion and knowledge of the managed product category 

 

 
 

 
 Joining our Company means working in a creative and international environment, with teams of people motivated by curiosity and the quest for excellence. The engine of our success is the importance and value that we place on the talent and passion of our people leading to their own professional growth. 
 Prada Group promotes an inclusive work environment, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or other personal characteristics. We believe that diversity is a value and we are committed to build a fair and respectful workplace for all.

Established in Northampton in 1873, the brand’s expertise quickly earned recognition from its modest beginnings – from a small workshop in Northampton to global expansion. Reinventing the English roots and championing timeless craftsmanship and traditions: Church’s long-established innovation and authenticity remains paramount with unique designs across shoes and accessories for men and for women. 

 
 

 
 

 JOB PURPOSE 

 
 

 
 To be the “ambassador” who convey and promote the Brand philosophy and Values to the final Clients guiding them into the world of the Brands. As such, to be responsible to maximize the individual and team sales, providing an extraordinary and memorable luxury customer experience placing the Client above all, discovering their needs and expectations, fostering meaningful relationships and developing their Brand loyalty. 

 
 

 
 

 
 RESPONSIBILITIES 

 
 

 
 

• Place the Customer at the center, creating a welcoming environment and striving to meet their every need and request, providing them with an excellence service in accordance to the “client journey ceremony”. 
 

• Capture Customer data into the Company CRM with the purpose of connecting to the client, maintaining and developing the relationships to offer a personalized approach and develop future opportunities. 
 

• Embrace and promote the Omni Channel mindset. 
 

• Work as a team player and partner with fellow colleagues, foster open and constructive communication, to ensure a consistent exceptional experience and contribute to a positive working environment, embracing Diversity and inclusion values.

The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church’s, Car Shoe and Luna Rossa brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities. JOB PURPOSE The incumbent is responsible for accounting activities relating to the maintenance of a complete and accurate general ledger and the resultant reports and financial statement. RESPONSIBILITIES ACCOUNT PAYABLES
• Manage Account Payable transaction and review the related evidence
• Perform Intercompany transaction recording and reconciliation
• Support vendor payment and employee reimbursement schedule with considering company rule
• Ensure compliance with Prada Group’s internal controls (ICoFR), tax regulations, and company policy
• Perform vendor communication for the payment queries and discrepancies
• Prepare monthly DPO (Days Payable Outstanding) analysis report GENERAL LEDGER MANAGEMENT
• Review PO/Expenses notes and authorize relevant documents
• Post Accruals and provisions for expenses OTHERS
• Prepare VAT filing quarterly
• Support internal and external audit
• Ad-hoc work for accounting

 JOB PURPOSE 

 
 

 
 To be responsible of managing the proper rotation of goods according to company regulations. To support the Stock Manager in all the responsibilities regarding the warehouse and the Store. Moreover, to deal with sales and therefore support the Sales Staff in order to maximize sales. 

 
 

 
 RESPONSIBILITIES

• Ensure the safety of the products and the valuable material in the warehouse during the whole handling process . 
 

• Assure the right product flow tracking through SAP system. 
 

• Always maintain order in the warehouse, according to the Corporate standards. 
 
 
 

• Guarantee the returns, shop-to-shop transfers, and e-commerce delivery following the corporate guidelines and deadlines. 
 

• Provide the orders of packaging material according to the store needs.

 Previous working experience in similar role

 English is a must other languages are a plus

JOB PURPOSE As Prada Client Advisor, You guarantee an extraordinary and memorable luxury customer experience, placing the Client above all, discovering their needs and expectations, fostering meaningful relationships, serving as a Brand Ambassador. You convey and promote the Brand philosophy and Values to the final Clients guiding them into the world of Prada. You hold yourself accountable to achieve your individual and team sales target, acting as proactive player in ensuring the best service and responding to the customer needs for both in store and on ecommerce channel. RESPONSIBILITIES • Place the Customer at the center, creating a welcoming environment and striving to meet their every need and request, providing them with an excellence service in accordance to the “client journey ceremony”; • Be driven to exceed individual sales targets and maximize own sales performances contributing to the success of the entire store; • Be driven to exceed KPI goals, ensuring the highest quality of sales and customer service; • Demonstrate an excellence knowledge of the products as well as Prada history, culture and DNA; • Capture Customer data into the Company CRM to connect to the client, maintain and developing the relationships to offer a personalized approach and develop future opportunities; • Embrace and promote the Omni Channel mindset; • Build and maintain an ample knowledge of the world of luxury fashion by being constantly informed on fashion trends and competitors, with the purpose to be able to discuss them with the customers and to give advises; • Take ownership of resolving Client complaints liaising with the line manager and Client Service team, when necessary; • Operate with the highest level of care and respect for the Products; • Utilize Company digital tools actively to offer a complete and integrated luxury experience; • Host and conduct customer appointments either in presence or leveraging technology to do virtual meeting; • Work in synergy with the Back of House, participating to the daily operations of the store and maintaining an organized stock room; • Act in compliance to Company procedures on operational guidelines and stock procedures, as well as security, cash activity, inventory, logistics and all main reporting activities requested by head office, ensuring that Company policies and procedures are proactively executed; • Work as a team player and partner with fellow colleagues, foster open and constructive communication, to ensure a consistent exceptional experience and contribute to a positive working environment, embracing Diversity and inclusion values. KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS Similar experience within a luxury or premium brand Understanding of luxury customer service Experience in building a long-lasting relationship with clients Being able to work in a team as well as alone Excellent communication and interpersonal skills Fluency in English Joining our Company means working in a creative and international environment, with teams of people motivated by curiosity and the quest for excellence. The engine of our success is the importance and value that we place on the talent and passion of our people leading to their own professional growth. Prada Group promotes an inclusive work environment, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or other personal characteristics. We believe that diversity is a value and we are committed to build a fair and respectful workplace for all.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church’s, Car Shoe and Luna Rossa brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities. 

 
 

 
 

 Job summary/purpose 

 
 

 
 As the Store Manager, you are a passionate Brand Ambassador and a business leader, who conveys the Brand philosophy and values to the local market, the Store team and to the final Client. 

 
 

 
 You are a driven business owner and you hold yourself accountable for achieving a successful overall store performance, seamlessly executing all activities to achieve the targets. 

 
 

 
 You guarantee excellence in Client experience, by being present on the sales floor and leading by example to placing the Client above all. 

 
 

 
 You are a motivating and inspiring leader; you coach and work closely with your team to achieve their sales target, maximizing all the commercial opportunities . Y ou mentor and develop your team by working closely with them; you set them up for success through succession planning and ensuring internal growth. 

 
 

 
 You ensure that Company policies and procedures are proactively put in place while managing all operational activities related to your Store. 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 
 Responsibilities 

 
 

 
 Leading the Business 

 
 

• Drive Store Team to exceed Financial targets and maximize sales performances, determining the success of the entire store
 

• Propose and develop action plans, through careful analysis of performance
 

• Drive the Store team to exceed their KPI targets, including cross selling and up selling among product categories
 

• Represent the Company within the local market, identifying opportunities to increase foot flow, attracting new Clients and building loyal relationships with the brand
 

• Be present on the sales floor, ensuring highest standard of approach and service to Clients.
 

• Foster the Omni Channel awareness among the team, as well as encourage and support the team in using digital tools to improve the relationship with clients and achieving the business
 

• Foster the E-commerce channel development through a timely response to orders received, always delivering a high standard of service
 

• Meet store operating budgets by monitoring store expenses
 

• Provide effective product feedback based on store needs, and participate in the buying session when requested
 
 
 

 
 

 
 Client Development 

 
 

• Place the Client above all, leading by example to create a welcoming environment and to ensure the Team strives to meet their every need and request
 

• Foster a Client centric mindset developing and maintaining solid Client relationships and enforcing meaningful after sales experiences
 

• Guarantee an excellent Client satisfaction and the highest level of Client service through the execution of the “Brand Selling Ceremony”
 

• Seamlessly manage the store’s local VIC’s, proposing the most appropriate and tailored actions to develop their loyalty and spend
 

• In partnership with other corporate functions, implement clienteling initiatives and events, securing Client loyalty and increasing Client spending
 

• Proactively identify opportunities to gain new Clients in order to grow store sales
 

• Foster a strong private appointment culture among the team
 

• Proactively manage any customer complaints to ensure client relationship is maintained with positive outcome
 
 
 

 
 

 
 Team Management 

 
 

• 
 

• Act as a strong Staff motivator, promoting team sp ı r ı t through effective communication, and cultivating a positive and energetic environment, even to the eyes of the Client
 

• Encourage the exchange of information within the team and proactively develop morning briefing on specific topics 
 

• Master fully all company tools and applications including IT and digital, and ensure team is constantly informed of relevant updates
 

• Understand the needs and priorities, train and inspire the Store team on product knowledge, sales techniques, Client Services, and Company policies and procedures 
 

• Identify talents within your team to propose for internal development opportunities, sharing the proposal with the Retail Operations Manager in order to define the correct development processes
 

• Guarantee team development through coaching and follow-ups on individual action plans;
 

• Attract and recruit the best talents available on the market through networking and scouting
 

• Ensure strong cooperation between front and back of house to guarantee efficient operations
 
 

 
 
 

 
 Boutique Care 

 
 

• 
 

• Lead by example to ensure the Team operate with the highest level of care and respect for the Product, evident in every ceremony or procedure
 

• Ensure display attracts Clients and maximizes sales, in accordance with Company guidelines – proactively seek VM and MD support based on store needs
 

• Guarantee an effective and efficient care of Company’s assets
 

• Ensure enforcement of Company procedures on cash activity, inventory, logistics and all main reporting activities requested by head office
 

• Prov ı de feedback and suggestions when necessary to the Visual Merchandising and the Retail Merchandising departments
 
 

 
 
 

 
 Events Organization 

 
 

• 
 

• Cooperate with the Retail Head Office for the organization of local events defining a challenging and realistic target per Client
 

• Guarantee excellence in standards and service during store events
 

• Propose opportunities for local events in partnership with local Stakeholders and Influencers
 
 

 
 
 

 

 
 

 
 Joining our Company means working in a creative and international environment, with teams of people motivated by curiosity and the quest for excellence. The engine of our success is the importance and value that we place on the talent and passion of our people leading to their own professional growth. 
 Prada Group promotes an inclusive work environment, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or other personal characteristics. We believe that diversity is a value and we are committed to build a fair and respectful workplace for all.

• Represent the Company within the local market, identifying opportunities to increase foot flow, attracting new Clients and building loyal relationships with the brand
 

• Be present on the sales floor, ensuring highest standard of approach and service to Clients.
 

• Foster the Omni Channel awareness among the team, as well as encourage and support the team in using digital tools to improve the relationship with clients and achieving the business

• Provide effective product feedback based on store needs, and participate in the buying session when requested
 
 
 

 
 

 
 Client Development 

 
 

• Place the Client above all, leading by example to create a welcoming environment and to ensure the Team strives to meet their every need and request
 

• Foster a Client centric mindset developing and maintaining solid Client relationships and enforcing meaningful after sales experiences
 

• Guarantee an excellent Client satisfaction and the highest level of Client service through the execution of the “Brand Selling Ceremony”
 

• Seamlessly manage the store’s local VIC’s, proposing the most appropriate and tailored actions to develop their loyalty and spend

•

descriptionByLocale.en:
Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church’s, Car Shoe and Luna Rossa brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities. 

 
 

 
 

 JOB PURPOSE 

 
 To be the “ambassador” who convey and promote the Brand philosophy and Values to the final Clients guiding them into the world of the Brands. As such, to be responsible to maximize the individual and team sales, providing an extraordinary and memorable luxury customer experience placing the Client above all, discovering their needs and expectations, fostering meaningful relationships and developing their Brand loyalty. 

 
 

 
 RESPONSIBILITIES 

 
 

• Place the Customer at the center, creating a welcoming environment and striving to meet their every need and request, providing them with an excellence service in accordance to the “client journey ceremony”. 
 

• Capture Customer data into the Company CRM with the purpose of connecting to the client, maintaining and developing the relationships to offer a personalized approach and develop future opportunities. 
 

• Embrace and promote the Omni Channel mindset. 
 

• Work as a team player and partner with fellow colleagues, foster open and constructive communication, to ensure a consistent exceptional experience and contribute to a positive working environment, embracing Diversity and inclusion values. 
 
 
 

• Welcome and serve the customer providing an excellent in-store experience at all times. 
 

• Be proactively engaged in cross selling with all Departments and maximizes sales opportunity in order to achieve individual sales target and KPIs. 
 

• Ensure to be up-to-date knowing fashion trends and competitors. 
 

• Prove Brand and product knowledge. 
 

• Deal effectively with customer complaints by liaising with the line manager when necessary. 
 

• Ensure and maintain the shop floor and visual display high standard, complying with Company operational guidelines and stock procedures. 
 

• Contribute to ensure a high level of security and is attentive to prevent product thefts. 
 
 
 

 
 

 
 KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS 

 
 Passion for selling and stores 

 
 Curiosity and interest in luxury/fashion, art and design 

 
 Experience of building a long-lasting relationship with clients 

 
 Being able to work in team as well as alone 

 
 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills 

 
 Ambition, resilience, self motivation, result driven and problem solving 

 
 Passion and knowledge of the managed product category
 English is a must other languages are a plus

- To guarantee an extraordinary Client experience, being present on the sales floor, leading and supporting all activities to achieve store targets.

- Ensure synergy and cooperation between front and back of house.

- Leadership and team management
- Ability to motivate and persuade people
- Strong customer service mindset
- Natural ability to welcome our client
- Confident, enthusiastic and positive
- Mature and assertive
- Organized and detail oriented
- Market and product knowledge/passion

- Interest in luxury/fashion, art and design

descriptionByLocale.en:
## Descrizione
Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church’s, Car Shoe and Luna Rossa brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities.

## JOB PURPOSE
As Outlet Sales Assistant, you guarantee an extraordinary and memorable luxury customer experience, placing the Client above all, discovering their needs and expectations, fostering meaningful relationships, serving as a Brand Ambassador.

You convey and promote the Brand philosophy and Values to the final Clients guiding them into the world of Prada Group.

You hold yourself accountable to achieve your store sales target, acting as proactive player in ensuring the best service and responding to the customer needs for both in store and on ecommerce channel.

## RESPONSIBILITIES
- Place the Customer at the center, creating a welcoming environment and striving to meet their every need and request, providing them with an excellence service in accordance to the “client journey ceremony”
- Be driven to exceed individual sales targets and maximize own sales performances contributing to the success of the entire store
- Be driven to exceed KPI goals, ensuring the highest quality of sales and customer service
- Demonstrate an excellence knowledge of the products as well as Prada / Miu Miu history, culture and DNA
- Capture Customer data into the Company CRM with the purpose of connecting to the client, maintaining and developing the relationships to offer a personalized approach and develop future opportunities
- Embrace and promote the Omni Channel mindset
- Build and maintain an ample knowledge of the world of luxury fashion by being constantly informed on fashion trends and competitors, with the purpose to be able to discuss them with the customers and to give advises
- Take ownership of resolving Client complaints liaising with the line manager and Client Service team, when necessary
- Operate with the highest level of care and respect for the Products
- Utilize Company digital tools actively to offer a complete and integrated luxury experience
- Work in synergy with the Back of House, participating to the daily operations of the store and maintaining an organized stock room
- Act in compliance to Company procedures on operational guidelines and stock procedures, as well as security, cash activity, inventory, logistics, ensuring that Company policies and procedures are proactively executed
- Work as a team player and partner with fellow colleagues, foster open and constructive communication, to ensure a consistent exceptional experience and contribute to a positive working environment, embracing Diversity and inclusion values

## KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS
- Passion for building long-lasting relationships with clients and peers
- Problem solving, curiosity and interest in luxury/fashion
- Experience in a luxury or premium retail environment is a plus
- Being able to work in team, as well as alone
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
- Fluent spoken English expected

## Cosa offriamo
Joining our Company means working in a creative and international environment, with teams of people motivated by curiosity and the quest for excellence. The engine of our success is the importance and value that we place on the talent and passion of our people leading to their own professional growth.
Prada Group promotes an inclusive work environment, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or other personal characteristics. We believe that diversity is a value and we are committed to build a fair and respectful workplace for all.

descriptionByLocale.en:
## Descrizione
Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church’s, Car Shoe and Luna Rossa brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities.

## JOB PURPOSE
You are a passionate Brand Ambassador and business leader who communicates the Brand’s philosophy and values to both the store team and the client. You take ownership of your department’s performance, actively supporting and implementing initiatives to achieve set targets. You ensure an exceptional client experience by maintaining a strong presence on the shop floor and leading by example, always placing the client at the forefront. As a motivating and inspiring manager, you coach and collaborate closely with your team to help them reach their sales targets and maximise all commercial opportunities.

## RESPONSIBILITIES
• Drive your Floor Team to exceed Financial as well as KPIs targets and maximize sales performances and contribution to support the success of the entire store.

• Support the management team to develop and implement business plans, through the analysis of the floor’s performance and proposal of relevant action plans.

• Be present on the sales floor, ensuring the highest standard of approach and service to Clients.

• Foster the Omni Channel awareness among the team, as well as encourage and support the team in using digital tools to improve the relationship with clients and achieve the business objectives.

• Foster the product knowledge wıthın the floor and work with relevant functions to support product/ collection training needs.

• Foster a client-centric mindset developing and maintaining solid Client relationships and enforcing meaningful after-sales experiences.

• Strengthen Client loyalty, supporting the department team to carry out clienteling initiatives.

• Proactively identify opportunities to gain new Clients in order to grow department sales.

• Proactively manage any customer complaints to ensure the client relationship is maintained with positive outcome.

• Act as a strong team motivator, promoting team spırıt through effective communication, and cultivating a positive and energetic environment

• Having understood the needs and priorities, train and inspire the floor sales team on product knowledge, sales techniques, Client Services, and Company policies and procedures.

• Guarantee team development through coaching and follow-ups on individual action plans.

• Actively support the management team in mapping the market for sourcing talent.

• Lead by example to ensure the team operates with the highest level of care and respect for the Product, evident in every ceremony or procedure.

• Support the enforcement of the Company procedures on cash activity, inventory, logistics and all main reporting activities requested by the head office.

• Provıde feedback and suggestions concerning floor needs firstly to the Store Director, and if necessary with the Visual Merchandising and the Retail Merchandising departments.

• Be the guarantor for an effectıve and effıcıent back of house organization for the floor, taking responsibility for the protectıon of the company’s assets as well as ensuring the staff grooming standard is maintained.

• Ensure that Company policies and procedures are proactively put in place while managing all operational activities related to your Departments.

• Ensure all the floor team is properly updated and trained on product knowledge and sales tools.

## KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS
• Ability to drive departmental performance by exceeding financial and KPI targets, identifying commercial opportunities, and contributing to overall store success - essential in high-performing luxury retail settings.

• Demonstrated skill in delivering exceptional client service through presence on the shop floor, execution of brand ceremonies, and proactive complaint resolution.

• Prior experience in luxury or premium brands is vital to meet elevated client expectations.

• Strong leadership and motivational skills to inspire, coach, and develop a sales team.

• Experience in fast-paced environments is key to maintaining energy and focus while nurturing talent.

• Effective communicator with the ability to share insights, lead briefings, and collaborate across departments. Staying informed on market trends, especially within the luxury sector crucial for maintaining relevance and driving innovation

## Cosa offriamo
Joining our Company means working in a creative and international environment, with teams of people motivated by curiosity and the quest for excellence. The engine of our success is the importance and value that we place on the talent and passion of our people leading to their own professional growth.
Prada Group promotes an inclusive work environment, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or other personal characteristics. We believe that diversity is a value and we are committed to build a fair and respectful workplace for all.

Job Summary/Purposes : The Assistant Store Manager has the ability of promoting brand loyalty to customers in the luxury goods sector, in order to guarantee the quantitative and qualitative objectives assigned. He/she represents the Company and acts as a representative of the Store Manager ensuring the implementation of all directions received from the Retail Department and Store Manager. Responsibilities: Sales • Is constantly up-to-date regarding fashion trends, knows and monitors competitors and communicates this information to the Sales Staff. • Reflects the corporate image in terms of standing and ensures that the Staff is also aligned. • Supports the Store Manager in guaranteeing excellent customer welcome and service and in maintaining the qualitative standards required by our brand. • • Supports the Store Manager in reporting all significant information to the Area Manager. Customer management and CRM • • Personally manages all critical situations regarding customer complaints and after-sales service. • Promotes customer loyalty. • Coordinates the management of Top clients as well as VIPs with the Store Manager. Store Staff • Supports the Store Manager in building the team and coordinating the activities in order to make sure that team members are always motivated and competent. • Ensures professional growth and training of the staff, sharing development plans with the Store Manager. • Supports the Store Manager and Department Managers in the definition of quantitative and qualitative objectives and ensures they are achieved by analyzing results, verifying monthly activities and setting up yearly assessments. • Prepares the Store Planning and submits it to the Store Manager for approval. • Manages Department Managers and supports them in their activities. • Makes sure that internal procedures are followed. Product • Ensures that the Store image and product care are in line with corporate standards and that the Staff is made to feel responsible to maintain these standards . • Knows in depth all the products for each category Visual • Ensures that the Store windows are always in good order and prepares product display strictly complying with the Company directions and following the indications provided by the Store Manager. Stockroom • Optimises stockroom management in order to make sure that stocks are stored as efficiently as possible in terms of sales, in cooperation with the stockroom staff. • Supervises and reports any discrepancies to the Store Manager. • Verifies the correct rotation of goods in the stockroom. • Provides the Stationary orders with the contingent Stock support • Supports the Store Manager in the management of all activities connected with year-end, sector and rotation stock takes by product category. Procedures • Takes any measures to guarantee the care of all valuable products and materials in the store, in cooperation with the Stock Manager. • Liaises with the Store Manager to report and manage any loss (thefts of products, money, etc.). • Liaises with the Store Manager to train the Store Staff to prevent losses and thefts. Reporting • Provides and analyses the main reports in terms of sales, products, staff performances, CRM and Stock. • Supports the Department Manager the reporting activity. Joining our Company means working in a creative and international environment, with teams of people motivated by curiosity and the quest for excellence. The engine of our success is the importance and value that we place on the talent and passion of our people leading to their own professional growth. Prada Group promotes an inclusive work environment, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or other personal characteristics. We believe that diversity is a value and we are committed to build a fair and respectful workplace for all.

• Capture Client data into the Company CRM with the purpose of connecting to the client, maintaining and developing the relationships (when CRM campaigns will be activated) to offer a personalized approach and develop future opportunities; • Embrace and promote the Omni Channel mindset; • Host and conduct client appointments either in presence or leveraging technology to do virtual meeting; • Work in synergy with the Back of House, participating to the daily operations of the store and preserving the stock room organized; descriptionByLocale.en:
## Descrizione
Church’s is a luxury shoemaker of rich innovation and traditional excellence, anchored in an exceptional heritage of English craftsmanship. Established in Northampton in 1873, the brand’s expertise quickly earned recognition from its modest beginnings – from a small workshop in Northampton to global expansion. Its patronage was bestowed by HM Queen Elizabeth II in 1965. In 1999, the luxury house was acquired by Prada Group, a paradigm of artisanal excellence in its own right and the ideal ally to help the shoemaker take its brand to the next chapter. Reinventing the English roots and championing timeless craftsmanship and traditions: Church’s long-established innovation and authenticity remains paramount with unique designs across shoes and accessories for men and for women.

## Mansioni

- Place the Customer at the center, creating a welcoming environment and striving to meet their every need and request, providing them with an excellence service in accordance to the “client journey ceremony”.
- Capture Customer data into the Company CRM with the purpose of connecting to the client, maintaining and developing the relationships to offer a personalized approach and develop future opportunities.
- Embrace and promote the Omni Channel mindset.
- Work as a team player and partner with fellow colleagues, foster open and constructive communication, to ensure a consistent exceptional experience and contribute to a positive working environment, embracing Diversity and inclusion values.
- Welcome and serve the customer providing an excellent in-store experience at all times.
- Be proactively engaged in cross selling with all Departments and maximizes sales opportunity in order to achieve individual sales target and KPIs.
- Ensure to be up-to-date knowing fashion trends and competitors.
- Prove Brand and product knowledge.
- Deal effectively with customer complaints by liaising with the line manager when necessary.
- Ensure and maintain the shop floor and visual display high standard, complying with Company operational guidelines and stock procedures.
- Contribute to ensure a high level of security and is attentive to prevent product thefts.

## Requisiti

- Passion for selling and stores
- Curiosity and interest in luxury/fashion, art and design
- Experience of building a long-lasting relationship with clients
- Being able to work in team as well as alone
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
- Ambition, resilience, self motivation, result driven and problem solving
- Passion and knowledge of the managed product category

## Cosa offriamo
Joining our Company means working in a creative and international environment, with teams of people motivated by curiosity and the quest for excellence. The engine of our success is the importance and value that we place on the talent and passion of our people leading to their own professional growth.
Prada Group promotes an inclusive work environment, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or other personal characteristics. We believe that diversity is a value and we are committed to build a fair and respectful workplace for all.

No contact information provided.

## Descrizione
Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church’s, Car Shoe and Luna Rossa brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities.

## Mansioni
- Inspire, drive, coach and support store teams in developing a client-oriented mindset, ensuring a proper understanding and constant execution of all clienteling activities for store teams
- Leverage on client and market analysis to set stores clienteling objectives, drive Private Appointment, Outreach, Prospect, support Store Managers to deep dive on client profiling with CA to target for events to achieved business results.
- To support client acquisition & retention, also leveraging on local market opportunities.
- Relationship with landlord, third-party, personal network for client development
- Identify and develop existing and new clients (prospects) to become future VICs
- Support store team on client’s personalized outreach and event invitation contents
- Support CRM Manager on clienteling processes, ensuring proper implementation and consistency of approach, supervise and promote the correct use of all Clienteling tools in stores.
- Support CRM Manager on Client Experience activities for local VIC, and offer highest level of experience in-store.
- Collecting CRM needs and sharing best practices.

## Requisiti
- Team working and organizational capabilities.
- Business development approach and clienteling mindset and curiosity.
- Results Orientation.
- Coaching capabilities and good communication skills

## Cosa offriamo
- Joining our Company means working in a creative and international environment, with teams of people motivated by curiosity and the quest for excellence.
- The engine of our success is the importance and value that we place on the talent and passion of our people leading to their own professional growth.
- Prada Group promotes an inclusive work environment, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or other personal characteristics.
- We believe that diversity is a value and we are committed to build a fair and respectful workplace for all.

## Contatto
No contact information provided.

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione Fondato nel 1913 in Italia, il Gruppo Prada è stato costruito su una tradizione di eccellenza e con una visione dell'innovazione. Il Gruppo, leader mondiale nel settore del lusso, opera in oltre 45 paesi con i marchi PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church’s, Car Shoe e Luna Rossa, e ha dipendenti di oltre 100 nazionalità. Come consulente clienti Prada, Lei garantisce una straordinaria e memorabile esperienza di cliente di lusso, ponendo il Cliente soprattutto, scoprendo le loro esigenze e aspettative, promuovendo relazioni significative, servendo come ambasciatore di marca. Voi trasmettete e promuovete la filosofia e i valori del marchio ai clienti finali che li guidano nel mondo di Prada. Si tiene conto di raggiungere il vostro obiettivo di vendita individuale e di squadra, agendo come giocatore proattivo per garantire il miglior servizio e rispondere alle esigenze del cliente sia nel negozio che nel canale di ecommerce. Prada Group promuove un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo, garantendo pari opportunità per tutti i candidati, indipendentemente dal sesso, dall'etnia, dall'orientamento sessuale, dalla disabilità o da altre caratteristiche personali. Crediamo che la diversità sia un valore e ci impegniamo a costruire un posto di lavoro giusto e rispettoso per tutti. ## Mansioni - Posizionare il cliente al centro, creare un ambiente accogliente e sforzarsi di soddisfare ogni loro esigenza e richiesta, fornendo loro un servizio di eccellenza in conformità con le procedure di viaggio cliente; - Essere guidato per superare i singoli obiettivi di vendita e massimizzare le proprie prestazioni di vendita contribuendo al successo dell'intero negozio; - Essere guidato per superare gli obiettivi di inclusione KPI, garantire la massima qualità delle vendite e del servizio clienti; - ## Requisiti - Passione nella moda, dinamica ed entusiasta; - almeno 2 anni di esperienza rilevante nelle vendite; - Candidato dal settore Luxury/Fashion/Cosmetics sarebbe un vantaggio; - orientato al cliente e forte sforzo per raggiungere le vendite; - Buona squadra-player e orientata ai risultati; - buon comando di cantonese, mandarino e inglese.
descriptionByLocale.de: Die 1913 in Italien gegründete Prada-Gruppe wurde auf einer Tradition der Exzellenz und mit einer Vision der Innovation aufgebaut. Mit den Marken PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church’s, Car Shoe und Luna Rossa betreibt die Gruppe, ein Weltmarktführer im Luxussektor, in mehr als 45 Ländern und beschäftigt über 100 Nationalitäten. Als Prada-Client-Advisor garantieren Sie eine außergewöhnliche und unvergessliche Luxus-Kunden-Erfahrung, die den Kunden vor allem bietet, ihre Bedürfnisse und Erwartungen zu entdecken, sinnvolle Beziehungen zu fördern, die als Brand-Botschafter dienen. Sie vermitteln und fördern die Markenphilosophie und -werte den Endkunden, die sie in die Welt von Prada führen. Sie halten sich verantwortlich, um Ihr individuelles und Team-Verkaufsziel zu erreichen, als proaktiver Spieler, um den besten Service zu gewährleisten und auf die Kundenbedürfnisse sowohl im Store als auch im E-Commerce-Kanal zu reagieren. Mit unserem Unternehmen zu arbeiten bedeutet in einem kreativen und internationalen Umfeld, mit Teams von Menschen motiviert durch Neugier und die Suche nach Exzellenz. Der Motor unseres Erfolgs ist die Bedeutung und Wert, die wir auf das Talent und die Leidenschaft unserer Menschen setzen, die zu ihrem eigenen beruflichen Wachstum führen. Die Prada Group fördert ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld, um Chancengleichheit für alle Kandidaten zu gewährleisten, unabhängig von Geschlecht, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, sexueller Orientierung, Behinderung oder anderen persönlichen Merkmalen. Wir glauben, dass Vielfalt ein Wert ist, und wir sind verpflichtet, einen fairen und respektvollen Arbeitsplatz für alle zu schaffen. Diversity-Beratung, Bereitstellung eines Exzellenz-Service in Übereinstimmung mit der “Client Journey Zeremonie”; - Werden Sie angetrieben, um die individuellen Vertriebsziele zu überschreiten und die eigenen Vertriebsleistungen zu maximieren, die zum Erfolg der gesamten Logistik beitragen; Requisiti - Leidenschaft in Mode, dynamisch und begeistert; - mindestens 2 Jahre relevante Erfahrung im Vertrieb; - Kandidat aus der Luxus-/Fashion/Cosmetics-Industrie wäre ein Vorteil; - kundenorientierte und starkes Streben nach Umsatz; - Gutes Team-Spieler und ergebnisorientierte; - Gutes Kommando von Kantonesisch, Mandarin und Englisch.
descriptionByLocale.fr: Descrizione Fondé en 1913 en Italie, le groupe Prada a été construit sur une tradition d'excellence et avec une vision de l'innovation. Le Groupe, leader mondial du secteur du luxe, opère dans plus de 45 pays avec les marques PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church, Car Shoe et Luna Rossa et compte plus de 100 employés de nationalités. En tant que conseiller client Prada, vous garantissez une expérience client de luxe extraordinaire et mémorable, plaçant le client avant tout, découvrant leurs besoins et attentes, favorisant des relations significatives, servant d'ambassadeur de marque. Vous transmettez et faites la promotion de la philosophie et des valeurs de la marque aux clients finaux les guidant dans le monde de Prada. Vous êtes tenu responsable d'atteindre votre objectif de vente individuelle et d'équipe, agissant comme acteur proactif pour assurer le meilleur service et répondre aux besoins des clients à la fois en magasin et sur le canal de commerce électronique. Rejoindre notre entreprise signifie travailler dans un environnement créatif et international, avec des équipes de personnes motivées par la curiosité et la recherche de l'excellence. Le moteur de notre succès est l'importance et la valeur que nous accordons au talent et à la passion de nos gens qui mènent à leur propre développement professionnel. Le groupe Prada favorise un milieu de travail inclusif, assurant des chances égales à tous les candidats, indépendamment du sexe, de l'origine ethnique, de l'orientation sexuelle, du handicap ou d'autres caractéristiques personnelles. Nous croyons que la diversité est une valeur et nous sommes déterminés à bâtir un milieu de travail juste et respectueux pour tous. ## Mansioni - Placer le Client au centre, créer un environnement accueillant et s'efforcer de répondre à tous leurs besoins et à toutes leurs demandes, leur fournir un service d'excellence conformément à la cérémonie du voyage client; - Être poussé à dépasser les objectifs de vente individuels et maximiser ses propres performances de vente contribuant au succès de l'ensemble du magasin; - Être conduit à dépasser les objectifs de KPI, en assurant la plus haute qualité des ventes et du service à la clientèle; - Démontrer une connaissance d'excellence des produits ainsi que de l'histoire, de la culture et de l'ADN de Prada; - Capturer les données du Client dans le CRM de l'entreprise dans le but de les connecter au client, de maintenir et de développer les relations afin d'offrir une approche personnalisée et de développer des opportunités futures; - Intégrer et promouvoir l'esprit d'Omni Channel; - Construire et maintenir une connaissance suffisante du monde de la mode de luxe en étant constamment informé sur les tendances de la mode et les concurrents, dans le but de pouvoir les discuter avec les clients et de donner des conseils; ## Requisiti - Passion dans la mode, dynamique et enthousiaste; - Au moins 2 ans d'expérience pertinente dans les ventes; - Candidat de l'industrie de luxe/Fashion/Cosmetics serait un avantage; - Orientation client et fort effort pour atteindre les ventes; - Bon team-player et axé sur les résultats; - Bonne maîtrise du cantonais, du mandarin et de l'anglais.

## Descrizione
Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church’s, Car Shoe and Luna Rossa brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities.

## Mansioni

### BUSINESS
- Ensure an exceptional welcome and customer service, fostering cross selling among the product categories.
- Analyze the department performance and define the actions required for achieving the business objectives.
- Give commercial suggestions to SM.
- Drive the team to exceed their KPIs.
- Be constantly up-to-date on market trend and share insights with relevant functions.
- Foster the ecommerce channel development.

### CUSTOMER
- Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction through excellent service.
- Strengthen customer loyalty by engaging and supporting the sales team in clienteling activities and gains new local customers to grow department sales.

### TEAM
- Train and inspire the sales staff of her/his department in product knowledge, sales techniques, customer services and company procedures.
- Identify high potential collaborators for internal development opportunities.
- Ensure effective communication and encourage information sharing and development of ad hoc morning briefing.

### RETAIL
- Guarantee an in-depth product knowledge within the department, working with the relevant functions to support product/collection training needs.
- Provide feedback and focused suggestions on department needs to the Store Manager.
- Guarantee the visual presentation of his/her department.
- Ensure effective and efficient back-of-house organization for the department and is responsible for the protection of the company’s assets as well as the staff grooming standards to be ensured.

## Requisiti

- Business driven

S/he supporterà programmi eCommerce e iniziative a livello WW e le relative capacità tecniche sviluppate sulle piattaforme di commercio. L'individuo lavorerà a stretto contatto con business e tecnologia conduce tra cui project manager, esperienza utente conduce, nonché agenzie e partner esterni. Come membro che lavora in un ambiente di team, lavorerà con architetti di piattaforma e sviluppatori su interpretazione/traduzione dei requisiti aziendali in architettura di destinazione, e successivamente in progettazione tecnica. I candidati qualificati devono avere un forte background di eCommerce con esperienza pratica nella definizione della strategia e della pianificazione della tecnologia digitale, supportando e implementando i siti transazionali costruiti sulle principali piattaforme di eCommerce. ## RESPONSABILITÀ - Proprio la soluzione globale di progettazione per iniziative di eCommerce. - Traduci i requisiti aziendali in soluzioni ben strutturate che sfruttano al meglio le piattaforme di commercio (ad esempio motori di commercio, CMS, OMS). - Fornire stime di sforzo e sviluppo di architettura di soluzioni di piombo, coordinando i partner esterni. - Condurre sessioni di progettazione tecnica all'architetto e documentare soluzioni tecniche allineate agli obiettivi aziendali. - Sviluppare POC rapido per la fattibilità della soluzione tecnica. - Supporta la fornitura tecnica di elementi di sviluppo, integrazione e migrazione dei dati personali - Fornisci indicazioni architettoniche sugli aspetti infrastrutturali, delle prestazioni e della scalabilità. - Collabora con i membri del team e gli stakeholder aziendali per promuovere il riutilizzo dell'architettura delle applicazioni, dei modelli e dei componenti. - Stabilire standard e linee guida per un uso efficace delle soluzioni eCommerce e la loro integrazione con altri sistemi core (ad esempio PIM, DAM, ERP). - descriptionByLocale.fr: Descrizione Fondé en 1913 en Italie, le groupe Prada a été construit sur une tradition d'excellence et avec une vision d'innovation. Le Groupe, leader mondial du secteur du luxe, opère dans plus de 45 pays avec les marques PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church, Car Shoe et Luna Rossa, et compte plus de 100 employés de nationalités. BUT DE L'EMPLOI Nous sommes à la recherche d'un architecte de solutions de commerce électronique qui fera partie du Département des technologies de l'information, qui sera chargé de diriger les activités de conception d'architecture d'applications pour les plateformes commerciales des marques du Groupe Prada. Il appuiera les programmes et les initiatives de commerce électronique au niveau de la WW et les capacités techniques connexes développées sur les plateformes commerciales. La personne travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les chefs d'entreprise et de technologie, y compris les gestionnaires de projet, les chefs d'expérience utilisateur ainsi que les organismes et partenaires externes. En tant que membre travaillant dans un environnement d'équipe, il travaillera avec des architectes et des développeurs de plateformes sur l'interprétation et la traduction des exigences commerciales dans l'architecture cible, puis dans la conception technique. Les candidats qualifiés doivent avoir une solide expérience du commerce électronique avec une expérience pratique dans la définition de la stratégie et de la planification de la technologie numérique, le soutien et la mise en œuvre de sites Web transactionnels construits sur les principales plateformes de commerce électronique. ## RESPONSABILITÉS - Possédez le plan de la solution globale pour les initiatives de commerce électronique. - Traduire les exigences commerciales en solutions bien architecturées qui tirent le meilleur parti des plateformes commerciales (p. ex. moteurs commerciaux, CMS, EMS). - Fournir des estimations de l'effort et le développement de l'architecture des solutions de pointe, en coordonnant les partenaires extérieurs. - Diriger les séances de conception technique à l'architecte et documenter les solutions techniques qui sont alignées sur les objectifs opérationnels. - Mettre au point un point de contact rapide pour la faisabilité des solutions techniques. - Soutenir la prestation technique des éléments de développement, d'intégration et de migration des données sur mesure. - Fournir des conseils architecturaux sur les aspects infrastructure, performance et évolutivité. - Collaborer avec les membres de l'équipe et les intervenants commerciaux pour promouvoir la réutilisation de l'architecture d'application, des modèles et des composants. - Établir des normes et des lignes directrices pour une utilisation efficace des solutions de commerce électronique et leur intégration avec d'autres systèmes de base (p. ex. PIM, DAM, ERP). - Veiller à ce que l'architecture de prestation soit mise en œuvre conformément aux politiques/normes et à ce que la solution soit évaluée à l'extérieur. ## CONNAISSANCES ET COMPÉTENCES - Diplôme en technologie de l'information, en informatique ou dans d'autres domaines pertinents - 5 ans et plus d'expérience en technologie dans les organismes de commerce électronique/numériques ou les cabinets de conseil, dirigeant, développant et concevant des applications d'expérience numérique, y compris les sites Web de commerce électronique, les systèmes de gestion des commandes, les capacités de gestion du contenu, les points de contact Web et mobile. - Une expertise en technologies web modernes et en architecture. - Expérience dans la conception et la mise en œuvre d'une ou de plusieurs plateformes eCommerce majeures (par exemple Salesforce Commerce Cloud, SAP Commerce Cloud, Shopify, VTEX, Commercetools) - Connaissance des processus et systèmes de gestion des commandes ainsi que de l'expérience dans les scénarios d'intégration omnicanal (l'expérience avec Fluent Commerce est un plus). - Connaissance des systèmes de gestion de contenu et d'autres technologies de marketing numérique telles que la gestion de campagne, DMP, CDP, médias sociaux, recherche, analyse et personnalisation web (expertise avec Adobe Experience Cloud ou CMS sans tête est un plus) - Connaissance de la plate-forme de surveillance et d'analyse de log (par exemple Splunk) est un plus. - Expérience éprouvée dans le déploiement de plateformes d'application mondiales. - Expérience dans le modèle de prestation agile (Safe est aussi plus) et expertise pratique avec des pratiques et des outils DevOps modernes – y compris mais sans s'y limiter – GIT, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, JIRA, Confluence, etc. - Réflexion innovante et la capacité de tirer parti de l'expérience technologique passée pour réussir dans un environnement entrepreneurial rapide. - Fortes compétences en analyse et en informatique. ## Cosa offriamo Rejoindre notre entreprise signifie travailler dans un environnement créatif et international, avec des équipes de personnes motivées par la curiosité et la recherche de l'excellence. Le moteur de notre succès est l'importance et la valeur que nous accordons au talent et à la passion de nos gens qui mènent à leur propre développement professionnel. Prada Group favorise un milieu de travail inclusif, assurant l'égalité des chances pour tous les candidats, indépendamment du sexe, de l'origine ethnique, de l'orientation sexuelle, du handicap ou d'autres caractéristiques personnelles. Nous croyons que la diversité est une valeur et nous sommes déterminés à bâtir un milieu de travail juste et respectueux pour tous.

Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church’s, Car Shoe and Luna Rossa brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities.

## Mansioni

### BUSINESS
- Drive and maximize sales performances.
- Propose and develop business plans.
- Drive the store team to exceed their KPIs.
- Represent the Company on the local market, identifying new opportunities to increase customer footfall, attracts new Clients and builds a loyal relationship with the brand.
- Be present on the sales floor, ensuring a proper approach and service to the Clients.
- Foster the Omni Channel development through the team.
- Meet the store-operating budget, controlling store expenses.

### CUSTOMER
- Foster a Client centric mindset by developing and maintaining solid Client relationships.
- Guarantee an excellent Client satisfaction and the highest level of Client service.
- Implement, in partnership with other company functions, clienteling initiatives and events, securing Client loyalty and increasing Client spending.
- Foster a strong private appointment culture.

### TEAM
- Promote an entrepreneurial and team spirit using effective communication, ensuring efficient organization and professional growth.
- Ensure the team is always prepared and updated on the Prada Group main information, product knowledge, local market, competitors, policies and procedures.
- The ideal Store Manager is able to attract and recruit the best talents available on the market through networking and scouting.

### RETAIL
- Develop a proper sales strategy, in cooperation with the Retail Merchandising, Visual Merchandising and Retail Operations teams.
- Ensures that the display attracts Clients and maximizes sales in accordance with Company guidelines.
- Participate in the buying session when requested and in any case he/she provides effective product feedback based on store needs.
- Ensure synergy and cooperation between front and back of house.
- Is responsible for the enforcement of Company procedures on cash activity, inventory, logistics and all the main reporting activities requested by the head office.

### EVENTS
- Cooperate with the Retail Events Office for the organization of local events and defines a challenging and realistic target per Client, proposing new opportunities for local events in partnership with local Stakeholders and Influencers.

## Requisiti
- Business driven
- Leadership and team management
- Ability to motivate and persuade people
- Strong customer service mindset
- Natural ability to welcome our client
- Confident, enthusiastic and positive
- Mature and assertive
- Organized and detail oriented
- Market and product knowledge/passion
- Business/Retail Management degree or equivalent is a plus
- Interest in luxury/fashion, art and design
- Spanish and English are a must

## Cosa offriamo
Joining our Company means working in a creative and international environment, with teams of people motivated by curiosity and the quest for excellence. The engine of our success is the importance and value that we place on the talent and passion of our people leading to their own professional growth.
Prada Group promotes an inclusive work environment, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or other personal characteristics. We believe that diversity is a value and we are committed to build a fair and respectful workplace for all.

Soyez présent sur le plancher des ventes, assurant une approche et un service appropriés aux clients. - Favoriser le développement du canal Omni à travers l'équipe. - Respecter le budget d'exploitation du magasin, contrôler les dépenses du magasin. ### CLIENT - Favoriser une mentalité centrée sur le client en développant et en maintenant des relations solides avec le client. - Garantir une excellente satisfaction du client et le plus haut niveau de service client. - Mettre en oeuvre, en partenariat avec d'autres fonctions de l'entreprise, des initiatives et des événements clients, en assurant la loyauté des clients et en augmentant les dépenses des clients. - Favoriser une forte culture de rendez-vous privé. ### ÉQUIPE - Promouvoir un esprit d'entreprise et d'équipe en utilisant une communication efficace, en assurant une organisation efficace et une croissance professionnelle. - S'assurer que l'équipe est toujours préparée et mise à jour sur les principales informations du groupe Prada, les connaissances des produits, le marché local, les concurrents, les politiques et les procédures. - Oui. L'idéal Store Manager est capable d'attirer et de recruter les meilleurs talents disponibles sur le marché grâce au réseautage et au scoutisme. ### RETAIL - Élaborer une stratégie de vente appropriée, en collaboration avec les équipes de marchandisation, de marchandisation visuelle et d'exploitation de détail. - S'assure que l'écran attire les clients et maximise les ventes conformément aux lignes directrices de l'entreprise. - Participer à la séance d'achat sur demande et, en tout cas, fournir une rétroaction efficace sur les produits en fonction des besoins des magasins. - Assurer la synergie et la coopération entre le devant et l'arrière de la maison. - Oui. Est responsable de l'application des procédures de l'entreprise sur les activités en espèces, les stocks, la logistique et toutes les principales activités de déclaration demandées par le siège social. ### EVENTS - Coopérer avec le Bureau des événements de détail pour l'organisation d'événements locaux et définir une cible difficile et réaliste par client, en proposant de nouvelles occasions d'événements locaux en partenariat avec les intervenants et les influenceurs locaux. ## Requisiti - Business drived - Leadership et gestion d'équipe - Capacité de motiver et de persuader les gens - Forte mentalité de service à la clientèle - Capacité naturelle d'accueillir notre client - Confiance, enthousiasme et positif - Mature et assurance - Organisé et axé sur les détails - Connaissance du marché et des produits/passion - Business/Retail Management est un plus - Intérêt pour le luxe/façon, l'art et le design - L'espagnol et l'anglais sont un must ## Cosa offriamo Rejoindre notre entreprise signifie travailler dans un environnement créatif et international, avec des équipes de personnes motivées par la curiosité et la quête d'excellence. Le moteur de notre succès est l'importance et la valeur que nous accordons au talent et à la passion de nos gens qui mènent à leur propre développement professionnel. Le groupe Prada favorise un milieu de travail inclusif, assurant des chances égales à tous les candidats, indépendamment du sexe, de l'origine ethnique, de l'orientation sexuelle, du handicap ou d'autres caractéristiques personnelles. Nous croyons que la diversité est une valeur et nous sommes déterminés à bâtir un milieu de travail juste et respectueux pour tous.

descriptionByLocale.en:
## Descrizione
Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church’s, Car Shoe and Luna Rossa brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities.

## JOB PURPOSE
We are looking for a IT Governance Specialist to join the Group IT Governance with the goal of supporting the function in managing "IT-for-IT" processes and the relationship with main IT function stakeholders.

The Candidate – operating within the team based at Headquarters level - will support the function in coordinating the IT project & portfolio, in managing the budgeting/monitoring & forecasting processes for the IT function, in designing the evolution of the IT Operating Model and supporting its adoption, and in coordinating interactions with the main stakeholders of the IT Group function. The candidate will work in establishing frameworks, policies, and tools to ensure IT investments align with business strategy, mitigating IT risks, managing security controls, conducting audits, and reporting to senior management to ensure operational efficiency and accountability.

## RESPONSIBILITIES
- Coordinate IT budget management and cost control
- Design / evolve and drive adoption of IT Operating and Delivery model (orga, role & responsibilities, sizing, tools, etc)
- Coordinate IT masterplan management and governance across different transformations streams
- Partner with senior stakeholders to align IT strategy with business objectives and value delivery
- Design, implement, and maintain IT governance frameworks
- Measure and monitor IT performance, delivery, and quality
- Develop managerial presentation as part of the CIO staff
- Support digitalization of IT processes, ensuring efficient management and adoption of governance tools
- Simplify IT4IT operations and interactions with other internal stakeholders to ensure alignment with business goals

## KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS
- Master’s degree, in Information Technology or Engineering fields
- 5 years of relevant experience in Retail, Fashion industry or IT consulting
- Knowledge of IT processes and services, preferably with a focus on the Retail and Fashion/Luxury sectors
- Strong competence and experience in managing budget / cost control processes, and enablement of tools to support it
- Knowledge of SDLC processes for both waterfall and agile methodologies, and related frameworks such as ITIL and SAFe
- Strong competence and experience in Operational Model design for IT functions (operational model, roles and responsibilities, procedures, sizing, organizational model) and change management for their adoption
- Strong attitude for continuous improvements and digitalization as strategic lever driving efficiency and simplification
- Experience in designing and developing presentations and data views to support IT Leadership
- Previous project and program management experience, preferably gained by tackling complex transformative programs
- Ability to prioritize effectively and work across different teams
- Public speaking, presentation skills and logical reasoning capability
- Organized and detail oriented
- Fluent in Italian and English, both written and spoken

## Cosa offriamo
Joining our Company means working in a creative and international environment, with teams of people motivated by curiosity and the quest for excellence. The engine of our success is the importance and value that we place on the talent and passion of our people leading to their own professional growth.
Prada Group promotes an inclusive work environment, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or other personal characteristics. We believe that diversity is a value and we are committed to build a fair and respectful workplace for all.

descriptionByLocale.en: Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church’s, Car Shoe and Luna Rossa brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities. JOB PURPOSE We are seeking a passionate and dedicated In-Store Trainer (m/f/d) to join our dynamic team in our PRADA Store in Munich. As an In-Store Trainer, you will partner with the Store Manager to develop talent, strengthen performance, and bring the Prada client experience to life through impactful training and coaching. At PRADA, we are renowned for our unwavering commitment to luxury, style, and innovation. As one of the global leaders in the fashion industry, we are dedicated to delivering exceptional experiences to our esteemed clientele. Our brand represents a fusion of tradition and modernity, and our Client Advisors play a pivotal role in providing personalized service and creating memorable moments for our discerning customers. RESPONSIBILITIES Partner with Store Manager and Leadership to identify training needs aligned with business priorities and develop targeted training action plans. Deliver and leverage in-store training tools (sessions, coaching, daily briefings, best-practice sharing) in collaboration with retail functions. Conduct team gap analyses, build individual coaching plans, and provide ongoing feedback on performance, progress, and skill development. Ensure full cascade, quality, retention, and impact of training content across Brand, Client Journey, and Product Knowledge, with strong shop-floor presence. Foster a self-learning culture, promoting digital training tools and continuous skill enhancement. Lead a strong culture of coaching, including shadowing, feedback, and “coach-the-coach” practices focused on selling excellence and client experience.
